utv.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
utv.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. There is also a farewell as bull Ezra's time on the farm comes to an end. Kelvin takes him to market in the hope of finding him a new home, marking another change among the farm's animals. Then it is all hands on deck for the Royal Cheshire Show. Liz and Kelvin pack enough farm produce to fill a huge marquee, along with the butcher's fridge to keep their Milo sausages chilled. With everything ready, they step into the world of trading and face a busy day behind the counter. (Reality) - 2023

utv.uk.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure - Orkney
utv.uk.description: James' adventure begins on the Orkney Islands, a place he's never been to and is excited to explore - he's also joined by top Scottish chef and good friend Nick Nairn for the journey. James gets straight to it and shops for hand-dived scallops before setting up his mobile kitchen in Stromness Harbour to make BBQ scallops with black pudding, apple and hazelnut butter - he then takes to the skies to visit North Ronaldsay, where the people are outnumbered by sheep, and cooks up some lamb chops. James's Orkney odyssey ends with a boat trip to catch its famous brown crab so he can rustle up a gorgeous Orkney crab pasta. (Documentary, Reality) - 2019

utv.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
utv.uk.description: The Fletchers are back at the Royal Cheshire Show, but this year they're swapping the show ring for trading. With their home range on display and Milo's sausages on the menu, can they win over the crowds across two busy days? With 3,000 sausages to sell, will Milo bring home some pocket money? Kelvin, meanwhile, misses having his cattle alongside him. A visit to the cattle sheds gives him the chance to admire this year's entries and learn more about dairy cows. For Marnie and her lamb Hope, it's an emotional journey towards their debut in the Young Handlers class. After plenty of practice, first-time nerves are running high, but preparations take a worrying turn when Kelvin spots maggots in Hope's fleece. With Hope's welfare the priority, can they get her fit and ready for the ring, giving Marnie the chance to put all her hard work into practice. (Reality) - 2023

bbc2.uk.title: Flog It
bbc2.uk.description: Antiques expert Elizabeth Talbot falls for a book of fairytales illustrated by Arthur Rackham, and Adam Partridge discovers an elegant chiming Swiss pocket watch. Paul Martin then meets one of the last remaining survivors of the Dunkirk evacuation during the Second World War.

bbc2.uk.title: House of Games
bbc2.uk.description: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Dame Laura Kenny, Minah Shannon, Seann Walsh and Ricky Wilson take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player.

bbc2.uk.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two

bbc2.uk.description: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Victoria Derbyshire.

bbc2.uk.title: Die Hard With a Vengeance (1995)
bbc2.uk.description: Third in the series of high-speed thrillers about maverick New York cop John McClane. This time the death-defying lawman, under suspension from the force, goes up against a madman who is threatening to detonate bombs all over Manhattan. McClane pulls out all the stops as he races against the clock to save the city. En route, a hostile Harlem shopkeeper becomes his reluctant partner in the adventure.

bbc2.uk.title: This City Is Ours
bbc2.uk.description: A long-time member of organised crime falls in love with Diana, prompting him to reevaluate his life and contemplate a future beyond his criminal activities.

bbc2.uk.title: A Course Called Ireland

bbc2.uk.title: Panorama
bbc2.uk.description: The BBC's climate editor, Justin Rowlatt, investigates the impact of the changing climate on our weather.

bbc2.uk.title: Piripenguins

bbc2.uk.description: Liko worries that Hattrem could be holding itself back for the sake of others.

bbc2.uk.description: Steve Backshall heads to downtown Perth in search of the most beautiful spider on earth.

bbc2.uk.title: Around the World in 80 Gardens
bbc2.uk.description: Monty Don visits the world's 80 most inspiring gardens: this time, in South East Asia. Since the 19th century, Western gardeners have loved the tropical garden. Monty visits the archetype - the mysterious Jim Thompson's Garden in Bangkok. He seeks something more authentic in the Royal Palace gardens and the floating gardens of the canals of Bangkok. In Bali, his preconceptions are challenged again.

bbc2.uk.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
bbc2.uk.description: My Life at Christmas: Anita Rani meets Rod Stewart and Penny Lancaster.

bbc2.uk.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking

bbc2.uk.title: Ice Cold in Alex (1958)
bbc2.uk.description: A British officer and his ambulance crew discover a German spy in their midst during a harrowing desert trek through Libya in 1942.

bbc2.uk.title: Homes Under the Hammer
bbc2.uk.description: In Nottingham, we see a Victorian town house with an unusual back garden, a couple hope to transform a dilapidated mid-terrace in Bournemouth, and a one-bedroom flat becomes an ultra-modern two-bedroom in north London. Dion, Martin and Tommy meet the successful bidders as we follow three unique renovations.

bbc2.uk.title: Flog It
bbc2.uk.description: We're at Wolverhampton Art Gallery. Antiques experts James Lewis and Caroline Hawley unearth a sword with a dark history and an early Moorcroft vase, while Paul Martin explores some of the region's industrial past.

bbc2.uk.title: Match of the Day Wales
bbc2.uk.description: Live coverage as Norway takes on Wales in the UEFA Nations League.

bbc2.uk.title: UEFA Nations League Football
bbc2.uk.description: Stephen Watson presents full match coverage from Windsor Park as Northern Ireland take on Ukraine in the UEFA Nations League. With just two matches remaining, Northern Ireland remain firmly in contention for promotion from League B. However, Ukraine could provide a major test as Michael O'Neill's side look to bolster their position ahead of a potentially decisive final fixture. Commentary is by Thomas Kane and Stephen Craigan.

bbc2.uk.title: 40 Hits of 1985 at the BBC
bbc2.uk.description: A trip into the BBC's archives for a selection of songs from 1985, including Elton John, Duran Duran, Foreigner, Billy Ocean, Marillion, Go West, Strawberry Switchblade and Kirsty MacColl.

bbc2.uk.title: Godland (2022)
bbc2.uk.description: At the end of the 19th century, a young Danish priest is sent to a remote part of Iceland. The deeper he travels into the Icelandic landscape, the more he loses a sense of his own reality, his mission and his sense of duty.

bbc2.uk.title: This City Is Ours
bbc2.uk.description: A long-time member of organised crime falls in love with Diana, prompting him to reevaluate his life and contemplate a future beyond his criminal activities.

bbc2.uk.title: Celebrity Race Across the World

bbc2.uk.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
bbc2.uk.description: Anita Rani meets Paralympian and broadcaster Ade Adepitan to hear his inspirational life story and how sport, spirituality and the festive season have shaped him. Anita discovers his life-affirming Christmas story, from contracting polio as a toddler in Nigeria, to growing up with a disability in east London in the 1970s, to the rocky road that led to Paralympic glory with the British wheelchair basketball team. Now a respected broadcaster, Ade shines a light on causes close to his heart.

bbc2.uk.title: Countryfile
bbc2.uk.description: Stories are shared of the people, places and issues at the heart of the British countryside. Popular features include the programme's photography contest, which culminates in a yearly calendar sold to benefit charity, the Video Diary.

bbc2.uk.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France

bbc2.uk.title: Spellbound (1945)

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Give Back to Others
bbc3.uk.description: Stay-at-home daughter Chi is suddenly forced to fend for herself when her parents die in a car crash. Chi learns she will only inherit the house on the condition she completes a list of `Things You Should Have Done' left in her parents' will. (Sitcom) - 2025

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Get a GCSE
bbc3.uk.description: Chi sets out to get an education but discovers a seismic betrayal. Lucas finds love at a touch-typing course. (Sitcom) - 2025

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Find a Life Partner
bbc3.uk.description: Chi casts a very wide net in search of a life partner and finds love at the cinema. Lucas crumbles under pressure at work, and Dave makes a questionable life decision. (Sitcom) - 2025

bbc3.uk.title: My Insta Scammer Friend
bbc3.uk.description: The infamous viral scandals of pioneering internet sensation Caroline Calloway have captivated audiences across the globe, with some of her followers left feeling duped and scammed. (Documentary, Special) - 2022

bbc3.uk.title: This Is BBC THREE
bbc3.uk.description: BBC THREE: Refreshing TV for the digital age. Tune in daily from 7.00pm. (Educational, Entertainment, Special) - 2008

bbc3.uk.title: This Is BBC THREE
bbc3.uk.description: BBC THREE: Refreshing TV for the digital age. Tune in daily from 7.00pm. (Educational, Entertainment, Special) - 2008

bbc3.uk.title: Doctor Who - The Battle of Ranskoor Av Kolos
bbc3.uk.description: On the planet of Ranskoor Av Kolos lie the remains of a brutal battlefield. As the Doctor, Graham, Yaz and Ryan answer nine separate distress calls, they discover the planet holds far more secrets. Who is the mysterious commander with no memory? What lies beyond the mists? Who or what are the Ux. (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2018

bbc3.uk.title: Doctor Who - Series 11 : Resolution
bbc3.uk.description: As the New Year begins, a terrifying evil is stirring, from across the centuries of Earth's history. As the Doctor, Ryan, Graham and Yaz return home, they must try to overcome the threat to the planet. (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2019

bbc3.uk.title: Miranda - The Dinner Party
bbc3.uk.description: Miranda has decided to prove to herself and her friends that she can officially be an adult. First by looking after a toddler, but the soft play centre is too much of a lure and she gets stuck in a kids' tunnel. Then by hosting a dinner party for eight. It ends in inevitable chaos. (Comedy) - 2013

bbc3.uk.title: Miranda - Je Regret Nothing
bbc3.uk.description: Miranda has been caring for her ill mother for five very long days. Trapped in her flat and being barked at by Penny, she is forced to think about her life regrets. Before she has the chance to tick off her bucket list she gets ill, and Tilly, Gary and Stevie offer no sympathy or help at all. (Comedy) - 2013

bbc3.uk.title: Gavin and Stacey
bbc3.uk.description: (Widescreen) Mathew Horne, Joanna Page, James Corden, Ruth Jones, Larry Lamb, Alison Steadman. First ever episode of the much-loved sitcom that launched Smithy onto the scene! After being phone buddies for months, Gavin and Stacey arrange a rendezvous in Leicester Square. (Subtitled, Audio Described). (Comedy, Romance, Comedy drama, Sitcom) - 2007

bbc3.uk.title: Gavin and Stacey
bbc3.uk.description: After a huge misunderstanding on the phone, Stacey thinks Gavin has finished with her. He drives to Wales to explain and ends up taking her home with him. Having never been further than Bridgend before, her trip to Essex is an eye-opening experience that ends with the biggest surprise of all. (Romance, Sitcom) - 2007

bbc3.uk.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
bbc3.uk.description: Kate Sharp, Rachel Baker, Lucas Jones Ho, Patrick Conlan and Ravi Saini are among the 30 comics picked from almost a thousand applicants to the BBC New Comedy Awards. Tonight, they compete for a place in the grand final at Birmingham Town Hall, where one act will be named BBC New Comedian 2026. Award-winning comedian Josh Pugh hosts. Each comic performs one set for the judges: stand-up and former winner Dan Tiernan, actor and improv comic Kiell Smith-Bynoe and head judge Amy Gledhill. (Comedy, Awards, Event, Standup) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
bbc3.uk.description: The BBC's comedy talent search is back. More than a thousand comics applied, and just 30 made it through to the heats. This is the last of six, and five more acts are competing for the last place in this year's grand final. The Box at Fargo Village, Coventry, will once again be converted into the BBC's own New Comedy Club. Mancunian ray of sunshine Josh Jones is our host for the night. (Comedy, Awards, Event, Standup) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: Man Like Mobeen - Prom Night
bbc3.uk.description: It's Aks's prom night, but there are rumours about debauchery at previous proms and the threat of a stabbing. Things get more complicated when a classmate of Aks's, Ridwan, makes some unwise decisions that leave Mobeen very concerned. (Drama, Sitcom) - 2019

bbc3.uk.title: Man Like Mobeen - Wrestling with the NHS
bbc3.uk.description: When Aks breaks her shoulder and heads for hospital with the boys, Accident and Emergency is the state of play. With Mobeen, Eight and Nate looking shifty, the authorities start to get suspicious about how Aks may have sustained her injuries. (Drama, Sitcom) - 2019

bbc3.uk.title: Man Like Mobeen - Return of the Pack
bbc3.uk.description: They say the past is never far away, and for Mobeen, it's about to punch him in the throat. Cal, an old friend, makes an unexpected return to Small Heath, leaving Aks, Eight and Nate very concerned about what it means for Mobeen. They wonder whether he can stay clear of trouble, or if things are about to take a turn for the worse. (Drama, Sitcom) - 2019

bbc3.uk.title: Man Like Mobeen - Fake News
bbc3.uk.description: Dogs and ethnic minorities have a very bad track record, so when a clip involving Mobeen and an Alsatian goes viral, it's a disaster. Aks is drawn in by internet fame, while Mobeen tries to see if the spark between him and Miss Aitken, Aks's teacher, is worth pursuing. However the past finally catches up with Mobeen, leaving him with some very difficult decisions to make. (Drama, Sitcom) - 2019

bbc3.uk.title: The Golden Cobra - Coal Hole
bbc3.uk.description: The Year 12s are left disappointed when their fun school trip is swapped at the last minute for a mining museum visit. Meanwhile, Mona grows frustrated with Connor. (Comedy, Animated) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: The Golden Cobra - Miss Port's Party
bbc3.uk.description: Miss Port throws a dinner party to celebrate Jub's new job and her new air fryer. Elsewhere, Basil's luck runs out when he is caught by the TV Licence men. (Comedy, Animated) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: The Golden Cobra - The College Gig
bbc3.uk.description: Rhys and his friends go to a college music gig after discovering that a girl in school might fancy him. But when he is threatened by Connor, they enlist local thug Malcolm to protect him. (Comedy, Animated) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: The Golden Cobra - Riding in Cars with Boyos
bbc3.uk.description: Mona promises to spend time with Miss Port's nihilistic goth daughter, Lambrini, while Miss Port and Jub go for dinner at a posh restaurant. The night takes a turn Jub doesn't expect. (Comedy, Animated) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: The Golden Cobra - Exceedingly Good Boiler Cover
bbc3.uk.description: After landing a huge sale at work, Jub goes on a big night out with his colleagues but struggles to keep up with them. Meanwhile, Basil begins to miss Jub. (Comedy, Animated) - 2026

bbc3.uk.description: Janet, Donna and Louise go shopping for Janet's wedding dress, and get into all kinds of trouble. Meanwhile, Jonny and Gaz discover a secret new kind of beer. (Comedy, Sitcom) - 2003

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Summer
eden.uk.plus1.description: It is high summer in the polar regions, and the sun never sets. Vast hordes of summer visitors cram a lifetime of drama into one long, magical day; they must feed, fight and rear their young in this brief window of plenty. Summer is a tough time for the polar bear family, as their ice world melts away and the cubs take their first swimming lesson. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Autumn
eden.uk.plus1.description: Polar landscapes in autumn are transformed as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some now battle to breed, and for the hardy few it's a time of opportunity. In the Arctic, polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast to wait for the return of the ice. Tempers soon fray and violent contests break out. Off the coast 2,000 beluga whales head for a special estuary, a gigantic `whale spa'. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Winter
eden.uk.plus1.description: Winter is the greatest test for life in the polar regions, as temperatures plummet to 70 below and winds reach 200kph. Only a few remarkable survivors gamble on remaining in these extreme conditions. In the Arctic, a female polar bear treks into the mountains to give birth. Out on the frozen ocean, the entire population of the world's spectacled eider ducks braves the winter in a giant ice hole. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - The Last Frontier
eden.uk.plus1.description: Revealing the extraordinary riches and wonders of the polar regions that have kept people visiting them for thousands of years. Today, their survival relies on a combination of ancient wisdom and cutting-edge science. Most Arctic people live in Siberia, either in cities like Norilsk - the coldest city on earth - or out on the tundra, where tribes like the Dogan survive by herding reindeer. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Manhattan Island
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael begins his American adventure on Manhattan Island. Starting at New York's Grand Central Terminal, he boards the Manhattan subway system, the busiest rail transit system in the US. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Brooklyn to Montauk
eden.uk.plus1.description: Beginning in Brooklyn, Michael hears the moving story behind the construction of the world's first steel suspension bridge high above the East River. Below ground, he investigates the arrival of New York City's first subway and the dangers faced by the men who built it: the `sandhogs'. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - New York City to Albany
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael follows America's iconic River Hudson north through New York State. Beginning at New York City's Penn Station, Michael rides the national rail carrier service, Amtrak. He hears from Amtrak's police chief how railroad policing began to tackle the nation's most notorious train robbers, among them Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Schenectady to Niagara Falls
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo braves the awesome power and drenching spray of Niagara Falls in the `Maid of the Mist' to share what artists, daredevils and millions of tourists have billed as one of the most spectacular experiences on the planet. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Abandoned Engineering - The Valkyrie Assassin
eden.uk.plus1.description: The underground base with the power to destroy a nation, the site linked with an attempt to kill a dictator, and an ancient world discovered in the American wilderness. (Documentary, News, Technology) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - South Coast Part 3
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo arrives in Southampton, a large port city that is home to many maritime and scientific agencies, such as the National Oceanography Centre. (Documentary, Travel)

After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles.

itv1anglia.uk.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. The last meeting between the sides came here 12 months ago, when the visitors scored seven tries in a 52-26 triumph. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams, and Jamie Roberts, with analysis by Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton, and Dan Biggar.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : England v Japan

England have won all six of the previous meetings between the nations, including a comfortable 59-14 victory here when the sides last faced each other two years ago, and they will expect to maintain that 100 per cent record today. With commentary by Nick Mullins and David Flatman, analysis from Ugo Monye and Maggie Alphonsi, and reports by Topsy Ojo.

itvwales.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Italy v Argentina
itvwales.uk.description: Live rugby from Round Five of the Nations Championship, as Italy host Argentina at the Stadio Luigi Ferraris in Genoa. Presented by Lauren Salter, with guests Jamie Roberts and Sam Warburton. Commentary comes from Nick Heath and Nolli Waterman. Every point counts as both sides look towards Finals Weekend at the Allianz Stadium in Twickenham at the end of the month. (Rugby)

itvwales.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Wales v New Zealand
itvwales.uk.description: Live rugby from Round Five of the Nations Championship, as Wales host New Zealand at the Principality in Cardiff. Presented by Lauren Salter, with guests Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton and Dan Biggar. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts. Every point counts as both sides look towards Finals Weekend at the Allianz Stadium in Twickenham at the end of the month. (Rugby)

itvwales.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: England v Japan
itvwales.uk.description: Eddie Jones returns to the Allianz Stadium as his Japan side take on England in the Nations Championship. Jones guided England to a World Cup final and three Six Nations titles during his seven year spell in charge, but will now pit his wits against Steve Borthwick who was part of his coaching set up during this time. Borthwick's England team are still a work in progress - but will be aiming for a repeat performance of their last outing against Japan in November 2024. (Rugby)

talkingpictures.uk.description: Swiftnick frees Aphrina, a gypsy girl from a forester's trap. In order to prove to her tribe he has not shamed the girl, Swiftnick must face three ordeals chosen by fate. (Action, Adventure, Biography, Entertainment) - 1982

talkingpictures.uk.title: Maigret - Raise Your Right Hand
talkingpictures.uk.description: Due to give evidence at a murder trial, Maigret is unable to shake his conviction that the accused is actually innocent. (Crime drama) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: Lillie - The New Helen
talkingpictures.uk.description: Lillie continues to captivate London society, having at one point to refuse the affections of an amorous King Leopold of Belgium. Her friend Oscar Wilde composes a poem for her called The New Helen, and cannot understand how she can remain in such a loveless marriage to Edward. But Lillie's fortunes are to change when she invites the Prince of Wales to dinner. (Drama, History) - 1978

talkingpictures.uk.title: Bellman and True (1987)
talkingpictures.uk.description: After losing his job and wife, computer engineer Hiller barely has time to pity himself before he's abducted by thugs looking to collect a debt for Salto. Salto has also had Hiller's teenage stepson kidnapped to ensure his complete cooperation. (Crime drama) - 1987

talkingpictures.uk.title: Eurotrash
talkingpictures.uk.description: Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, we solve the secret of the moving nipple, look into the mystery of wee willy winky, watch as Lolo makes a ham sandwich and see a man getting nibbled.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Yanky Panky - Episode 1
talkingpictures.uk.description: Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities, and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society. (Comedy) - 2000

talkingpictures.uk.title: Runaway Train (1985)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Philosophical action thriller about two escaped prisoners who hide on board a train speeding through Alaska. The driver suffers a fatal heart attack and the train races out of control through the icy wilderness. With the railroad signalmen unable to stop it and a vindictive prison warden desperately pursuing them by helicopter, the train's passengers look set to face disaster. Based on a screenplay by Akira Kurosawa. (Action) - 1985

talkingpictures.uk.title: A Saint, A Woman, A Devil
talkingpictures.uk.description: Sylvia is a seemingly quiet and saintly person. But she is hiding a promiscuous multiple personality disorder.

talkingpictures.uk.title: To The Four Corners
talkingpictures.uk.description: From Kilkeel in Northern Ireland to Lincoln Cathedral, travel across the four corners of the United Kingdom in 1956.

talkingpictures.uk.title: One Step Beyond - The Forests of the Night
talkingpictures.uk.description: A group of businessmen on a vacation divert themselves with a Chinese lacquer box reputed to have magical powers. (Science fiction, Anthology) - 1960

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Atomic Submarine (1959)
talkingpictures.uk.description: When a series of unexplained accidents destroys shipping in the Arctic Circle, an American submarine is dispatched to investigate. The discoveries made by the crew could spell the end of civilisation. (Science fiction / Thriller) - 1959

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dial 999 - 77 Bus
talkingpictures.uk.description: Police are baffled by robberies known as `The Red Rose series', Maguire and his partner suspect a seemingly innocent jeweller.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sherlock Holmes - The Case of the Shoeless Engineer
talkingpictures.uk.description: A mute girl tries to warn an engineer that he will soon be killed. (Mystery) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Twist or Stick
talkingpictures.uk.description: A 1960s twisting compilation featuring `The Hollies', Shane Fenton & The Fentones, The Orchids, The Keytones and much more. (Entertainment, Music, Special) - 2021

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Four Feathers (1939)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A British Army officer redeems himself from charges of cowardice when he quells a native rebellion in Sudan. (Adventure) - 1939

talkingpictures.uk.title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer (1957)
talkingpictures.uk.description: The frontiersman leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief. (Adventure) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Railway Children (2000)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Set in Yorkshire at the dawn of the 20th century, this is the story of three children whose father has been wrongfully imprisoned for espionage, though they know nothing of this; their mother refuses to tell them why the police took away their father. So, the children spend their free time exploring the mystery of their father's disappearance and gazing at the nearby railroad in the hope that it will somehow bring them an answer. (Drama) - 2000

talkingpictures.uk.title: That's My Boy - The Phantom of the Farmyard
talkingpictures.uk.description: Mrs Price wants to move in with Angie, Ida and Robert because she's lonely in London. The trio hatch a plan to put her off the idea. (Sitcom) - 1985

talkingpictures.uk.title: For the Love of Ada - Bowling
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ada's convinced that the baby is overdue, and Walter gambles his months pension. (Sitcom) - 1971

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Man From U.N.C.L.E - The Birds and the Bees Affair
talkingpictures.uk.description: THRUSH sends bees to murder. (Crime drama) - 1966

together.uk.title: Lake District Rescue
together.uk.description: The team are called out to a man who's broken his leg on Scafell Pike. With darkness closing in, leaving him in plummeting temperatures could be life-threatening. (Documentary, Medical) - 2024

together.uk.title: Case Sensitive
together.uk.description: Conclusion of the two-part detective drama. After a mother and daughter are found dead in strange circumstances, a mysterious young woman calling herself Esther visits the crime scene. DS Charlie Zailer and DC Simon Waterhouse track the woman to a bird sanctuary but she disappears, leaving behind only a photograph of an unknown mother and child. Who are they - and what is their connection to the dead family. (Crime drama) - 2011

together.uk.title: The Good Karma Hospital
together.uk.description: Ruby is still reeling from her discoveries at the tea plantation and must decide if she can forgive past mistakes. Mari goes head to head with Lydia when a surrogate mother gives birth in the hospital. (Drama, Medical) - 2018

together.uk.title: Love Your Garden - The Rendall Family
together.uk.description: Alan Titchmarsh and his team continue the fifth series of the garden makeover show. This week Alan and the gang are in Chessington, where they create a car-themed garden with some of the most inventive features ever seen in the series. The quirky outdoor sanctuary is for an unlikely hero - hospital worker and vintage car enthusiast Alan Rendall. In July 2014, Alan discovered his neighbour's house was on fire and immediately went to the rescue. The two families had been close friends.

together.uk.title: Perfect Friday (1970)
together.uk.description: A staid bank employee decides to break loose from his humdrum life and use his position to change his life. A beautiful customer and her jaded aristocratic husband, desperate for cash to maintain their jet-set existence, provide the ideal accomplices for the perfect crime. (Comedy / Crime drama) - 1970

together.uk.title: Coffy (1973)
together.uk.description: A woman poses as a prostitute and seeks revenge on those who got her sister hopelessly addicted to drugs. Armed with a shotgun, she hits the streets in search of those responsible. (Drama) - 1973

together.uk.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver (1976)
together.uk.description: A happy-go-lucky London cabbie and dozens of beautiful women constitute a cab-full of romance. (Comedy) - 1976

together.uk.title: Sort Your Life Out
together.uk.description: Working mum Toyah, US-born dad Ron, and their three kids, moved from a big house in the US into a much smaller house in the UK. Unfortunately, they forgot to downsize their possessions and are now stuck in a home that doesn't serve its purpose. (Home improvement, House/garden, Reality) - 2023

together.uk.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Roadtrip - Venice
together.uk.description: Clive loves Venice, but on this trip, he wants to learn what it's like to be a local, outnumbered by tourists by over 200 to 1. He hitches a lift with a rare female gondolier and learns the tough craft of steering with one oar, gets a lesson in glass-blowing from his new friend Count Gibi, and finds out why Italian vegetables taste so great as he picks peppers on a farm in the Venetian lagoon.

together.uk.title: Flipping Profit - Hay-On-Wye
together.uk.description: Philip Serrell, top trader Melissa Downhill and upholsterer Micaela Sharp head to Hay-on-Wye where they have just one day to find some bargains that they can turn into some flipping profit. When the time is up, the next stage of the challenge begins, and they have just three weeks to turn their buys into booty.

together.uk.title: Honour Among Thieves (1968)
together.uk.description: Two former French Foreign Legion members plan to break into the vault of a French corporation. But are they being set up? Charles Bronson and Alain Delon star in this hit film. (Drama) - 1968

together.uk.title: Dirty Heroes (1968)
together.uk.description: Two escaped POWs team up with a Dutch loyalist to steal Allied plans and Dutch diamonds from Nazi headquarters. (Action) - 1968

together.uk.title: Puppet on a Chain (1972)
together.uk.description: A member of Interpol's Narcotics Bureau ventures to Amsterdam to flush out a gang of heroin smugglers. When a fellow agent is shot dead, he is forced to team up with the local Dutch force. The stage is set for a breathtaking speedboat chase through the canals of Amsterdam. (Thriller) - 1972

together.uk.title: Midnight In St. Petersburg (1997)
together.uk.description: Harry, a former secret agent, opens his own private investigation bureau in St Petersburg. When his associate's girlfriend is kidnapped, he must do everything he can to find her. (Thriller) - 1997

together.uk.title: Fanny Hill (1983)
together.uk.description: Happily engaged to her handsome fiance, Fanny is soon hit with one misfortune after another until she is forced to become a prostitute to survive. She struggles to regain pride in herself and find happiness in life once again. (Drama / Romance) - 1983

together.uk.title: Frustrated Wives (1974)
together.uk.description: A pair of frustrated housewives who are bored and neglected by their husbands decide to go to a sex clinic in the country. Contains nudity. (Comedy / Erotic / Adult) - 1974

together.uk.title: Murphy's War (1971)
together.uk.description: An Irish seaman vows to settle the score with a U-boat that sank his ship off the Venezuelan coast. The sole survivor after the German sub has strafed the sea with machine-gun fire, he takes refuge in a mission and then discovers that the U-boat is still in hiding up river. (Drama / War) - 1971

together.uk.title: Queer Lives Today - Come Out Fighting
together.uk.description: Tom Gaisford's film follows a gay trans man stepping into the ring for a boxing fight. This knockout documentary gives you a ringside seat to a situation gaining notoriety. (Documentary, Gay/lesbian) - 2022

amc.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
amc.us.description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2017

amc.us.title: Die Hard
amc.us.description: New York City policeman John McClane is visiting his estranged wife and two daughters on Christmas Eve. He joins her at a holiday party in the headquarters of the Japanese-owned business she works for. But the festivities are interrupted by a group of terrorists who take over the exclusive high-rise, and everyone in it. Very soon McClane realizes that there's no one to save the hostages -- but him. (Action, Thriller) - 1988

amc.us.title: Die Hard 2
amc.us.description: A year after his heroics in L.A., detective John McClane (Bruce Willis) is mixed up in another terrorist plot, this time at Washington Dulles International Airport, where he is waiting for his wife (Bonnie Bedelia). That same night, South American politico and drug profiteer Ramon Esperanza (Franco Nero) is arriving in U.S. custody. McClane takes action when a treasonous ex-colonel (William Sadler) seizes control of the airport, threatening to crash every inbound flight unless Esperanza is freed. (Action, Thriller) - 1990

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 -- Parabellum
amc.us.description: After gunning down a member of the High Table -- the shadowy international assassin's guild -- legendary hit man John Wick finds himself stripped of the organization's protective services. Now stuck with a $14 million bounty on his head, Wick must fight his way through the streets of New York as he becomes the target of the world's most ruthless killers. (Action, Thriller, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2019

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
amc.us.description: With the price on his head ever-increasing, legendary hit man John Wick takes his fight against the High Table global as he seeks out the most powerful players in the underworld, from New York to Paris to Japan to Berlin. - 2023

amc.us.title: Die Hard 2
amc.us.description: The sequel's police hero (Bruce Willis) spots military terrorists while waiting for his wife (Bonnie Bedelia) at a Washington, D.C., airport. - 1990

amc.us.title: A Bronx Tale
amc.us.description: The son of an honest bus driver looks up to a local mob boss amid racial tension in the 1960s New York. - 1993

amc.us.title: Rudy
amc.us.description: With heart and determination an Illinois youth (Sean Astin) tackles shortcomings to play Notre Dame football. - 1993

amc.us.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
amc.us.description: Robots and other allies help a youth (Mark Hamill) and a space jockey (Harrison Ford) rescue a rebel princess (Carrie Fisher) and battle dark forces bent on intergalactic rule. - 1977

amc.us.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
amc.us.description: The adventure continues in this "Star Wars" sequel. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), Han Solo (Harrison Ford), Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) and Chewbacca (Peter Mayhew) face attack by the Imperial forces and its AT-AT walkers on the ice planet Hoth. While Han and Leia escape in the Millennium Falcon, Luke travels to Dagobah in search of Yoda. Only with the Jedi master's help will Luke survive when the dark side of the Force beckons him into the ultimate duel with Darth Vader (David Prowse). (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1980

amc.us.title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
amc.us.description: Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) battles horrible Jabba the Hutt and cruel Darth Vader to save his comrades in the Rebel Alliance and triumph over the Galactic Empire. Han Solo (Harrison Ford) and Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) reaffirm their love and team with Chewbacca, Lando Calrissian (Billy Dee Williams), the Ewoks and the androids C-3PO and R2-D2 to aid in the disruption of the Dark Side and the defeat of the evil emperor. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1983

amc.us.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
amc.us.description: The Imperial Forces -- under orders from cruel Darth Vader (David Prowse) -- hold Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) hostage, in their efforts to quell the rebellion against the Galactic Empire. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) and Han Solo (Harrison Ford), captain of the Millennium Falcon, work together with the companionable droid duo R2-D2 (Kenny Baker) and C-3PO (Anthony Daniels) to rescue the beautiful princess, help the Rebel Alliance, and restore freedom and justice to the Galaxy. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1977

amc.us.title: The Perfect Storm
amc.us.description: Based on a true story, the film tells of the courageous men and women who risk their lives every working day, pitting their fishing boats and rescue vessels against the capricious forces of nature. Their worst fears are realized at sea on Halloween of 1991, when they are confronted by three raging weather fronts which unexpectedly collide to produce the greatest, fiercest storm in modern history -- "The Perfect Storm." (Thriller, Drama, Adventure, Action) - 2000

amc.us.title: The Three Stooges - Three Little Pigskins
amc.us.description: While dressed for a promotional campaign, the Stooges are mistaken for "Horsemen of Boulder Dam," college football players; they are asked to play privately for a gangster. (Comedy) - 1934-12-08

amc.us.title: The Three Stooges - Punch Drunks
amc.us.description: Curly becomes enraged whenever he hears the tune "Pop Goes the Weasel"; fight manager Moe plans to take full advantage. (Comedy) - 1934-07-13

amc.us.title: Beverly Hills Cop
amc.us.description: After his childhood buddy is murdered while visiting Detroit, rebellious cop Axel Foley (Eddie Murphy) follows the leads to Beverly Hills, Calif., under the auspices of a vacation. He checks in with old friend Jenny Summers (Lisa Eilbacher) and starts to believe her boss, art dealer Victor Maitland (Steven Berkoff), might somehow be involved in the murder. However, Lt. Bogomil (Ronny Cox) of the Beverly Hills Police Department does not trust Foley, and hinders his search for evidence. (Action, Thriller, Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1984

amc.us.title: Beverly Hills Cop II
amc.us.description: The hard-nosed Detroit cop returns to Los Angeles to help solve another case. This time he must direct his efforts towards unraveling the Alphabet Crimes, a series of robberies committed by leather-jacketed punks. The investigation puts him on the trail of an illegal arms dealer and his hit lady. (Action, Crime drama, Dark comedy, Thriller) - 1987

babytv.uk.title: Olly
babytv.uk.description: Make way for Olly the doctor who is on his way to cure Dolly. Does she need a band aid? Some rest? Maybe some tickling?

babytv.uk.title: Stitches
babytv.uk.description: Needles, Racky, Hoppy, Bouncy and Castor all have fun at the playground. They play on the seesaw, the swing and with a skipping rope.

babytv.uk.title: Play & Learn with Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam Bam are making sock puppets! Want to join them? It's easy. Don't forget to bring socks, buttons, ponpons and some wool!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: If you have a mouse near your house why don't you try dancing with it? Wiggle your tail and start sniffing!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Wag your tail and put up your paws - come dance like a cat. Don't forget "Meow"!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Get ready to rumble in the jungle with an elephant! Flap your ears, stomp your feet and blow the trumpet!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Baby Hippo is learning how to walk. On his way he meets a flying butterfly, a jumping frog and a crawling snail.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie and "Number Three" on their search for the secret ingredient of vanilla peanut brittle before they set out to the Numbers Party.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie and Number Four on their journey to find colors for four drawings before heading off to the Numbers Party.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Charlie, Square and Parallelogram try to fix a hole in the bridge. Who will be able to fill the hole?

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Charlie and Circle play hide and seek. Circle is very good at hiding, will Charlie be able to find him?

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: All aboard! Captain Trapezoid and Charlie are going sailing. Oh no! Captain Trapezoid has forgotten his sails.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny play "what doesn't belong", have fun pretending to be cats and play with puppets.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny play hide and seek, have fun pretending to be dogs and play with colors.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny have fun pretending to be frogs, playing the animal game and "what's hiding beneath the handkerchief.

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: A steering wheel! Play the sound game to hear a blender's sound! Can you guess what's in the hidden picture game? A mouse!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: A comb! What item is missing to complete the 3-of-a-kind game? A steering wheel! Find the missing turtle piece!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Draco has fun ice skating with Billy and Bambam, a snowman and a Christmas tree.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola helps a family of bears cross the road, helps a cat off a tall tree, finds out what's in the box grandma has brought grandpa.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Giraffe get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: The bears play soccer in the park when their ball gets stuck in the tree. How will they get it down? Lola takes a ride on a bus.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal has a woolen fleece! Come along and see which animal has a beak and a funny comb!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal has big horns! Come along and learn which animal has whiskers and pointy ears!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: Jon Jon gets stuck in a trap on a tall tree while getting some fruit. Luckily Ari is there to help.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Join Mr. Snail on his adventure to discover where bananas grow! Mr. Snail meets parrot and learns that they repeat what they hear!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a smart street cat! Find out where cat plays and sleeps! See his paws and claws!

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Harley is playing catch with a toucan. Things get out of hand when Harley sails the ship right into a mountain and the air is coming out of the balloon.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: What is everyone up to today? Mixing water and soap, making pink soap bubbles! It's fun to make bubbles, but it's much more fun to float in them.

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli is supposed to take a bath beofre going to bed. But he doesn't want to! so what does he do? He tries to hide from Baloo.

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A blower arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused blower discover its true use?

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A hand mixer arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused hand mixer discover its true use?

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Johnny and Hal want to ride together, but they can't... Johnny rides too fast, and Hal rides too slowly.

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: It's Christmas and Bunny wants lights on her bike that look like shiny colorful candy. Will Mike be able to help?

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Johnny and Tommy want a superhero bike so they can go save the princess in the tower. Will Mike have a solution? S1 Ep8

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become farmers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a tractor and a scarecrow! S1 Ep8

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become clowns! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a clown hat and a red nose! S1 Ep9

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Join the mighty mice builders as they work and play! Come sing along and help them build their new home! What's inside the package? A lemon? Of course not! It's a lovely vase! S1 Ep2

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they find a broken yellow car with two missing wheels and turn it into a snow sled, pretending to slide over the snow!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they have fun with the washing basket, turning it into a boat and sailing the sea!

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby helps Rabbit bake a carrot cake with fresh carrots from Rabbit's garden.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Hippo invites Giraffe and Baby to sail in his boat.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Turtle makes freshly squeezed orange juice for Baby.

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy are fishing in the bathtub! Froggy catches a treasure chest with a crown inside!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy are sailing on a boat in the bath! Is that a rock blocking their way? Come and discover a cute turtle!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy are playing hide and seek. Join Ducky as he climbs a rock to find the friends and discovers a turtle!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends play with a doctor's bag and go on treating a frog, a hedgehog and a bird. S1 Ep10

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: Come play ball and see it turn into a hot air balloon! Join the ride, float on fluffy clouds and slide down a sparkling rainbow!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: What's inside the box? A beautiful red shoe! Join the friends as they set out on a journey in a shoe that turns into a car!

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: When Yum Yum comes to see him, Uh Oh says he can't dance so Yum Yum teaches him and all the friends dance together!

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Join Yum Yum and his friends as they enjoy eating a surprise lunch despite cooking flops.
