As Isaac prepares to become a first-time father, the friends realize that their annual tradition is coming to a sad end. To make it as memorable as possible, they plan a night of debauchery and hilarity by searching for the Nutcracka Ball, the Holy Grail of Christmas parties in New York. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2015

But her image-conscious mother's fears and Lenore's own deep self-loathing prevent her from wearing her own designs. Will Lenore ever feel the self-love she inspires in others? (Comedy drama) - 2024

starzcomedy.us.title: City Island
starzcomedy.us.description: Prison guard Vince Rizzo (Andy Garcia) wants to quit his job to become an actor, but he also needs to make up for lost time with Tony (Steven Strait), a long-lost son who's an inmate where Vince works. When Tony is freed, Vince suggests the ex-convict move in with his wife, Joyce (Julianna Margulies), and their children. But because Vince neglects to tell his family that Tony is not just a stranger, but the son he fathered before he met Joyce, this leads to a series of comic misunderstandings. (Comedy) - 2009

starzcomedy.us.title: Pixels
starzcomedy.us.description: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet. (Comedy, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2015

starzcomedy.us.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days

Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire. (Romantic comedy) - 2003

starzcomedy.us.title: Surfer, Dude
starzcomedy.us.description: Steve Addington is a professional surfer and beach bum who lives to ride the waves. Content simply to live in the moment, he has a dilemma when his finances dry up and businessman Eddie Zarno offers to hire him for a virtual reality game. Since there are suddenly no good waves in the ocean, Addington must reconsider Zarno's offer and ponder his place in the world. Struggling with the choice, Addington seeks advice from his friends. As the two renew their interest in each other, Patti's teacher friend, Kate (Debra Messing), also rekindles her college relationship with Michael (Edward Burns), a lawyer and mutual friend. As the fate of Earth hangs in the balance, the team is put to the ultimate test as they battle Ultron, a technological terror hell-bent on human extinction. Joleen soon runs off with a truck driver, and James is unable to meet his responsibilities. starzinblack.us.title: Mindhunters
starzinblack.us.description: FBI agent Jake Harris (Val Kilmer) escorts a group of cadets to a remote island for simulation training. The cadets, under the leadership of J.D. (Christian Slater), will try to catch an imaginary serial killer within the island's elaborate facility. The FBI, however, is suspicious of Harris' methods and dispatch Gabe Jensen (LL Cool J) to act as an outside observer. What he finds is a simulation exercise that becomes dangerously real and training that becomes a fight for survival. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2004

starzinblack.us.title: Premium
starzinblack.us.description: Reginald "Cool" Coolidge is an actor hoping for his big break away from stereotypical black roles. When his ex-fiancée, Charli, pulls in to the gas station where he works, Cool realizes that he still loves her after three years apart. But there is one problem: Charli's wedding to another man is only 36 hours away. Desperate to win her back, Cool uses his talents as an actor to convince Charli that she is choosing the wrong man. (Comedy drama) - 2006

starzinblack.us.title: All About the Benjamins
starzinblack.us.description: Bounty hunter Bucum Jackson (Ice Cube) teams with the small-time con artist, Reggie Wright (Mike Epps), that he is pursuing, in an attempt to locate a missing stash of diamonds and a lottery ticket worth millions of dollars. Bucum and Reggie find themselves in a race to the finish as they embark on an unlikely partnership that should -- when all is said and done -- prove beneficial to them both. (Action, Comedy) - 2002

starzinblack.us.title: Don't Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood
starzinblack.us.description: Innocent young black man Ashtray (Shawn Wayans) is forced to move into a tough Los Angeles slum with his family, including his oddly streetwise, pot-smoking grandma (Helen Martin). Before long, Ashtray's nuclear-armed gangster cousin Loc Dog (Marlon Wayans) introduces him to a bizarrely comic crime underworld. Luckily, Ashtray falls for urban poet Dashiki (Tracey Cherelle Jones), and she convinces him to go straight -- but he must deal with her manic ex-boyfriend Toothpick (Darrel Heath). (Comedy) - 1996

starzinblack.us.title: Pain & Gain
starzinblack.us.description: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story. (Action, Comedy drama) - 2013

starzinblack.us.title: Scandalize My Name
starzinblack.us.description: Black filmmakers, actors and scholars recall their experiences with discrimination during the Red Scare. (Special, Documentary) - 1999-02-06

starzinblack.us.title: The Longest Yard
starzinblack.us.description: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them. (Comedy) - 2005

starzinblack.us.title: Brick Mansions
starzinblack.us.description: In a dystopian Detroit, grand houses that once housed the wealthy are now homes of the city's most-dangerous criminals. Surrounding the area is a giant wall to keep the rest of Detroit safe. For undercover cop Damien Collier (Paul Walker), every day is a battle against corruption as he struggles to bring his father's killer, Tremaine (RZA), to justice. Meanwhile, Damien and an ex-con named Lino (David Belle) work together to save the city from a plot to destroy it. (Action, Crime drama) - 2014

starzinblack.us.title: Something New

Impressed with his work on a friend's mansion, McQueen hires Kelly to design her new garden -- and he sweeps her off her feet. But, after her friends introduce her to executive Mark Harper, McQueen must choose between the type of man she always dreamed she wanted and giving in to life's little surprises. starzinblack.us.title: The Call

teennick.us.description: The Loud kids help Flip clean up his image to impress his middle school crush; when the Mortician's Club can't afford tickets to Casket Con, they decide to start a business to raise money.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Grub Snub; She's All Bat
teennick.us.description: When Leni and her friends start hanging out at Gus', Lincoln and the gang start a turf war for control; Lucy gets jealous of Lola's newfound attention after she joins the Mortician's Club.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - House of Lies; Game Boys
teennick.us.description: After witnessing an excess of lying in the family, Lisa invents lie-detecting glasses to try and curb the fibs; Lincoln asks to borrow Clyde's new gaming system, but Clyde struggles to trust that it's safe with him.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Scream Machine
teennick.us.description: When Charlotte's invention for a TV show is accidentally destroyed and then rebuilt, Charlotte worries that the attention she gets could expose Kid Danger and Captain Man's secret identity.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Time Jerker
teennick.us.description: When Kid Danger and Captain Man battle the Time Jerker, Kid Danger accidentally falls into the Time Jerker's time machine and relives the same day over again.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Opposite Universe
teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte travel to an opposite universe where evil counterparts of Ray and Schwoz want to destroy Piper.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Secret Beef
teennick.us.description: Henry receives an invitation to Swellview's most exclusive restaurant, and decides to bring his boss, Ray.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Jasper Danger
teennick.us.description: When Jasper dresses as Kid Danger for Halloween, a case of mistaken identity causes the real Kid Danger and Captain Man to come to his rescue.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Man: On Vacation
teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte are in charge of protecting Swellview while Ray is out of town at his cousin's wedding.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Stuck in Two Holes
teennick.us.description: Charlotte and Jasper must come to the rescue when Captain Man and Kid Danger are each stuck in a hole.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Secret Room
teennick.us.description: Captain Man reveals a Crime fighters Only room in the Man Cave; when Charlotte, Jasper and Schwoz make a cooler room to show them up, the gang fights over who gets the better room and things get blown out of proportion.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Super Volcano
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray think the world is ending when a dormant super volcano under Swellview becomes active; Piper is convinced that she has gluten intolerance.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Story Tank
teennick.us.description: Big steaks are on the line when Henry claims he can't be scared; Schwoz uses a machine that allows Henry to virtually experience the spooky stories that everyone in the Man Cave tells him in an attempt to prove Henry wrong.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Man of the House
teennick.us.description: After Henry's mother's purse is stolen, Captain Man decides he must move in with Henry's family in order to protect them.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Invisible Brad
teennick.us.description: Captain Man's friend, who was accidentally turned invisible, shows up for a visit, but quickly overstays his welcome.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Twin Henrys
teennick.us.description: Henry has a shape-shifting android fill in at a family dinner so that he can watch an MMA fight with Charlotte and Ray.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Game of Phones
teennick.us.description: When a young girl chains herself outside Junk-N-Stuff, Kid Danger and Captain Man are forced to help find her beloved phone; while on a stakeout, they unexpectedly run across some familiar faces with a devious plan.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Toddler Invasion
teennick.us.description: When the Toddler takes control of the Man Cave, Charlotte and Jasper have to find a way to sneak in and free Kid Danger and Captain Man.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Budget Cuts
teennick.us.description: When the Vice Mayor cuts Captain Man and Kid Danger's budget to build a high-speed railway in Swellview, the duo must figure out creative ways to save money.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Flabber Gassed

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Rubber Duck
teennick.us.description: When Ray accidentally destroys Henry's dad's prized remote control car, they throw a manicure/pedicure party to raise money to fix it.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Man-kini
teennick.us.description: When a new internet celebrity causes havoc in Swellview, Captain Man has to swap bodies with Frankini to infiltrate his secret lair. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-12

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Toads and Tiaras; Two Boys and a Baby

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Bummer Camp; Sleepstakes

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Cover Girls; Save the Date

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Left in the Dark; Get the Message

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Along Came a Sister; Chore and Peace
teennick.us.description: Lincoln must care for the class tarantula; Lincoln decides to go on strike until someone will swap chores. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-04

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Driving Miss Hazy; No Guts, No Glori
teennick.us.description: Finally tired of doing favors for Lori to get rides, Lincoln decides to help Leni pass her driver's test; Lincoln and nine of his sisters work as a team to thwart the tyranny they face with Lori as their babysitter. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-10

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Linc or Swim; Changing the Baby
teennick.us.description: All ten of Lincoln's sisters want to use the new kiddie pool he has purchased, but it is not large enough for all of them; after noticing that none of his sisters share his interests, Lincoln tries to mold Lily into his mini-me. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-18

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Stall Monitor; A Pimple Plan
teennick.us.description: Worried that his teacher has bad things to say about him, Lincoln tries to delay his parent-teacher conference; Luan wakes up with a pimple on the day of her first date with Benny, so she turns to the siblings for help. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-11-09

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Diss the Cook; For Sale by Loner
teennick.us.description: Lincoln is convinced the middle school lunch lady is holding a grudge against him and his older sisters; Mr. Grouse attempts to find some peace and quiet after moving away from the Louds. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2021-11-12

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Camped!
teennick.us.description: When Dad discovers that his childhood camp is closing, he decides to take the family for one final visit; they soon uncover a map that could lead to a treasure big enough to save the camp and prove the existence of an old camp legend. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2021-05-31

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Snow Escape; Snow News Day

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Butterfly Effect; The Green House
teennick.us.description: Lincoln spills one of Lisa's experiments, setting off a chain reaction throughout the house; Lincoln tries to encourage the family to stop using so much electricity. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-06-08

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Fashion No Show; Doom Service
teennick.us.description: Leni and Carlota's working styles clash when they are both interning for a famous fashion designer, Mariella Moss; the Louds book a stay at an all-inclusive resort, only to find the vacation is not what they imagined. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Sitcom) - 2023-05-11

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Runaway McBride; High Crimes
teennick.us.description: Howard and Harold tear their home apart after Clyde starts spending more time with the gang and less time at home; Sunset Canyon is falling apart and Lincoln and Clyde are determined to find out why. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-03-04

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - How the Best Was Won; Animal House
teennick.us.description: A competition creates a rift; Lana struggles to find homes for the exotic pets at the Royal Woods Animal Shelter before they're moved out. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2021-10-29

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Can't Hardly Wait; A Mutt Above
teennick.us.description: Lori takes a job as a waitress at Dad's restaurant, but it turns out that serving is harder than she anticipated; spurred on by a classmate's mocking about Charles, Lana decides to train him to compete in a local dog show. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-10-27

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Absent Minded; Be Stella My Heart
teennick.us.description: Clyde discovers he didn't earn junior administrator job, but can't give up the perks that come along with it; when the new girl starts hanging around Lincoln and his friends, they begin to suspect she likes one of them. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2018-08-15

teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte want to tell Jasper that Henry is really Kid Danger, so they decide to give him a test secret to prove that he is ready. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-04-18

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: The Contractor
themoviechannel.us.description: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. (Action, Thriller) - 2022

themoviechannel.us.title: Paycheck
themoviechannel.us.description: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Mystery) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Along Came a Spider
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear
themoviechannel.us.description: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Barron's Cove
themoviechannel.us.description: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
themoviechannel.us.description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child. - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: Match Point
themoviechannel.us.description: A one-time tennis professional (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) becomes obsessed with his brother-in-law's (Matthew Goode) seductive fiancée (Scarlett Johansson). - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Basic Instinct
themoviechannel.us.description: A woman suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick ensnares a San Francisco cop in a web of lust and deceit. - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: A veteran cop (Billy Bob Thornton) and an assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen) track an ex-convict (Dwayne Johnson) who is on a mission to take revenge on his brother's killers. - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Red Eye
themoviechannel.us.description: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official. - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Hugo
themoviechannel.us.description: A resourceful orphaned boy (Asa Butterfield) and a bookish girl (Chloë Grace Moretz) set out on a quest to unlock a secret left to him by the boy's late father (Jude Law). - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: The Brothers Grimm
themoviechannel.us.description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest. - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: The Stepford Wives
themoviechannel.us.description: A man and his wife move to a quaint suburb where most of the women seem to have the same bland personality. - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 2
themoviechannel.us.description: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college. - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 3
themoviechannel.us.description: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived. - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
themoviechannel.us.description: A blundering Los Angeles detective (Leslie Nielsen) and his boss (George Kennedy) foil a plan to assassinate Queen Elizabeth. - 1988

themoviechannel.us.title: Old School
themoviechannel.us.description: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. (Comedy) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike
themoviechannel.us.description: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister. (Comedy drama) - 2012

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike XXL
themoviechannel.us.description: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again. (Comedy drama) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Private Parts
themoviechannel.us.description: The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives. (Biography, Comedy) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 2
themoviechannel.us.description: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. (Horror, Comedy) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Flight of the Intruder

Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thirteen Women
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Female alumnae of the St. Albans Seminary sorority group receive letters from Swami Yogadachi, making alarming predictions of death and murder -- which come true. When Helen Frye (Kay Johnson) receives her prediction, she contacts sorority leader Laura Stanhope (Irene Dunne), who invites the remaining members to come to her home. On the journey there, Helen meets Ursula Georgi (Myrna Loy), a half-Indian, unaware that Ursula's fury over her treatment in college is behind the swami's predictions. (Thriller) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Thirteenth Chair
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A medium holds a seance to clear her daughter of murder in colonial India. (Mystery) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dementia 13
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After John Haloran dies, his wife, Louise, fears that she will be denied his inheritance. Fabricating a story about John traveling to the United States, she joins the rest of the Haloran family at their Irish estate as they hold a memorial for John's sister, who died in a lake eight years ago. Louise schemes to convince Lady Haloran that she can speak with the dead child. However, this plan is interrupted by an axe murderer loose on the estate. (Horror, Thriller) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Woman on Pier 13
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Communists blackmail a San Francisco shipper (Robert Ryan) and recruit his wife's (Laraine Day) brother (John Agar) with a blonde. (Crime drama) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thirteen Frightened Girls
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A diplomat's teenage daughter (Kathy Dunn) spies with the daughters of diplomats from 12 different countries. (Thriller) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 13 Ghosts
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Cyrus Zorba and his poverty-stricken family inherit an old mansion, they can't believe their good luck. However, not long after they move in they realize that the house is haunted by 12 ghosts and run by a housekeeper who works in the dark arts. Though the ghosts are intent on killing a member of the family, the Zorbas insist on staying in the house because they have learned that a large fortune is hidden somewhere inside it. (Horror) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Hour of 13
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Nicholas Revel (Peter Lawford) steals a famous jewel, but when police find a corpse at the crime scene, they start to believe that the person behind the theft also committed several murders. Nicholas isn't a killer, however, and he appeals to Jane Frensham (Dawn Addams), the daughter of a top policeman, for a hand in finding the murderer. As police close in on Nicholas, digging through his apartment for clues linking him to the murders, he gets closer to unmasking the real killer. (Mystery) - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A slow detective (Victor McLaglen) puzzles over backstage murders in between numbers at a New York theater. - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Fort Apache
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An Arizona cavalry captain sees his stubborn colonel lead troops into a massacre. - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Clash of the Titans
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Perseus (Harry Hamlin), son of the Greek god Zeus (Laurence Olivier), grows up on a deserted island. His destiny is to marry Princess Andromeda (Judi Bowker), who will someday rule the city of Joppa. But as long as the satyr Calibos (Neil McCarthy) -- who uses a giant vulture to kidnap Andromeda's soul every night -- is alive, no one can marry her. Perseus travels to Joppa, where he must defeat Calibos and other mythological monsters to rescue Andromeda. (Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 1981

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this classic adventure film, two rough-and-tumble wanderers, Dobbs (Humphrey Bogart) and Curtin (Tim Holt), meet up with a veteran prospector, Howard (Walter Huston), in Mexico and head into the Sierra Madre mountains to find gold. Although they discover treasure, they also find plenty of trouble, not only from ruthless bandits lurking in the dangerous Mexican wilderness but from their own insecurities and greed, which threaten to bring conflict at any moment. (Adventure, Western, Drama) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Killing
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Career criminal Johnny Clay (Sterling Hayden) recruits a sharpshooter (Timothy Carey), a crooked police officer (Ted de Corsia), a bartender (Joe Sawyer) and a betting teller named George (Elisha Cook Jr.), among others, for one last job before he goes straight and marries his fiancée, Fay (Coleen Gray). But when George tells his restless wife, Sherry (Marie Windsor), about the scheme to steal millions from the racetrack where he works, she hatches a plot of her own. (Crime drama) - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Slander

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: American Graffiti
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: On the last day of summer vacation in 1962, friends Curt (Richard Dreyfuss), Steve (Ronny Howard), Terry (Charles Martin Smith) and John (Paul Le Mat) cruise the streets of small-town California while a mysterious disc jockey (Wolfman Jack) spins classic rock'n'roll tunes. It's the last night before their grown-up lives begin, and Steve's high-school sweetheart, a hot-to-trot blonde, a bratty adolescent and a disappearing angel in a Thunderbird provide all the excitement they can handle. (Comedy drama) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Young Runaways
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Three teens (Brooke Bundy, Kevin Coughlin, Patty McCormack) join other lost souls on the street in Chicago's hippie district. (Drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Calling All Husbands
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A henpecked husband (Ernest Truex) whose wife bemoans their marriage presents to her a past suitor (George Tobias), a crook on the lam. (Comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Calling Philo Vance
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Trying to get information on airline mogul and accused spy Archer Coe, sleuth Philo Vance soon finds himself investigating a murder when Coe turns up dead. Because Coe was such a widely disliked and unethical character, everyone in his orbit becomes a suspect — even his niece, the strong-willed Hilda Lake. Hopping from one continent to another, Vance must piece together a complicated set of clues in order to close the case. (Mystery) - 1940

641290.title: Autopsy: The Last Hours of...

641290.title: Autopsy: The Last Hours of...

641290.title: Autopsy: The Last Hours of...
641290.description: Chyna's life unravelled after she left WWE and she became infamous as a casualty of drug and alcohol abuse.

641290.title: Autopsy: The Last Hours of...
641290.description: Randy "Macho Man" Savage was one of the most daring and most competitive in the ring; Randy was famous for his aggressive demeanor and his colorful outfits and stunts, and he was regarded as one of the greatest pro-wrestling showmen.

641290.title: Autopsy: The Last Hours of...

moremax.us.title: Black Adam
moremax.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Lady Bird
moremax.us.description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school. (Comedy drama) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Mojave
moremax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

moremax.us.title: The Perfect Match
moremax.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
moremax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
moremax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: The Dilemma
moremax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Spring Breakers
moremax.us.description: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work. - 2012

moremax.us.title: Bring Her Back
moremax.us.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother. - 2025

moremax.us.title: Companion
moremax.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. - 2025

moremax.us.title: Head Office
moremax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. - 1986

moremax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
moremax.us.description: When his boss (John Tormey) turns against him, a hit man (Forest Whitaker) who lives like a samurai must fend for his life. - 1999

moremax.us.title: Batman
moremax.us.description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) saves dismal Gotham City and gorgeous Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger) from the freaky Joker (Jack Nicholson). - 1989

moremax.us.title: Batman Returns
moremax.us.description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) clashes with Catwoman (Michelle Pfeiffer) and saves gloomy Gotham City from the foul Penguin's (Danny DeVito) plot. - 1992

moremax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
moremax.us.description: A dying Secret Service agent (Kevin Costner) who wants to reconnect with his estranged daughter (Hailee Steinfeld) is offered a potentially lifesaving drug in exchange for completing one final mission. - 2014

moremax.us.title: The Nun
moremax.us.description: Vatican officials send a priest and a novitiate to investigate the suicide of a young nun in Romania. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when they encounter a demonic force that takes the shape of a nun. - 2018

moremax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
moremax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

moremax.us.title: The Predator
moremax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Nerve
moremax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Scream
moremax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

moremax.us.title: Girls Trip
moremax.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Comedy, Drama, Adventure) - 2017

moremax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
moremax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

sbssydney.au.description: In March 2021, a group of highliners unite to bridge a 777m gap - Australia's longest. A soulful glimpse into the daring, community, and spirit of highlining.

sbssydney.au.title: The Graveyard Of Truk Lagoon

sbssydney.au.title: Byzantium: Secrets Of An Empire
sbssydney.au.description: From the rise of Constantinople to the fall of Byzantium, this documentary explores a thousand years of history, art and power that shaped Europe and connected East and West.

sbssydney.au.title: Secret Sardinia Mysteries of the Nuraghi
sbssydney.au.description: Sardinia hides the remains of an ancient civilisation. A team of archaeologists and scientists has been studying the ruins to unlock the secrets of one of the most remarkable Bronze Age cultures.

sbssydney.au.title: Ancient Superstructures
sbssydney.au.description: S3 E2 The Great Sphinx - Carving The Lion King The Sphinx is the most monumental ancient sculpture in the world. Half-man, half-lion, this monument arouses the curiosity of the whole world.

sbssydney.au.title: Ottoman Empire By Train
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Alice Roberts begins her Ottoman adventure in Adana. She explores an historic mosque, finds out about the origins of Turkish delight, and takes a train across the Taurus Mountains to Konya.

sbssydney.au.title: Ottoman Empire By Train
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Alice Roberts is on a train to Ankara on her Ottoman adventure. She visits the tomb of Ataturk who saw out the end of the empire. Next, a train to the tomb of Osman, the empire's founder, in Bursa.

sbssydney.au.title: Ottoman Empire By Train
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 Alice Roberts finally arrives in Istanbul to learn about the clever Ottoman tactics required to wrestle the city from the Romans.

sbssydney.au.title: Ottoman Empire By Train
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Entering The Balkans by sleeper train Alice Roberts is in Bulgaria's capital Sofia. She'll learn how the empire was controlled from Istanbul and how today, the landscape is almost entirely Soviet.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E30 Hair Today, Gone Tomorrow Medusa visits Hotel Transylvania and soon after she arrives, someone starts messing with Aunt Lydia's hair. Medusa is obviously suspect number one and yet she's nowhere to be found.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 The Case Of The Perplexing Painting When Esther's painting is damaged during the Art Show, Maudie has trouble proving who ruined the artwork without finding the evidence first.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E16 Frenemy The Girls are charmed by the coolest girl in school.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E14 Witches Garden When a witch casts a spell on Jake stealing his powers, they must go on a quest to find them again.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E16 Private Lake The Bears have fun at Charlie's private lake.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E33 Wally T The Titans discover the magic of \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E21 Dearest Family Galette day this year is eventful for Marinette; Tikki is acting very strange and three supervillains show up! Will Ladybug still manage to establish herself as queen of the day?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Moominvalley
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 The Strange Case of Mrs Fillyjonk When Moominmamma is accused of an unlikely crime, Moomintroll turns detective to try to save her. Can he succeed where his father couldn't?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mechamato
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E4 Fulus Pyramid When Mara is trapped inside a board game owned by the bad robot Fulus the First, it is up to Amato and friends to beat the game and free themselves.

ABCMESydney.au.title: 100% Wolf: Legend of the Moonstone
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Night Of The Poodle Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy's entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits (and his best friend Batty's help) to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E3 Renn Scare The gang heads to the Velma's beloved authentic Renaissance Faire, where they must find a way to infiltrate the royal feast in order to stop an evil court jester from ending the king's reign.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E1 A Barb is Born On the third day of the world, Barb tries to save the ferns from being eaten by the spotted bears. But the bears are only getting hungrier and hungrier - will Barb be able to stop the ferns from going extinct?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Drama Island: Reboot
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Meet the Victims Chris welcomes 16 new campers back to the original island and divides them into two teams who face-off in a blindfolded challenge that's sure to cause pain.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E16 What About Blob? Mavis and Wendy are feeling suffocated by the grown-ups in their lives. They'd do anything to get them off their case. The solution? They set them up on an ill-advised date.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E36 Dear Diary Bonnie steals Jim's diary and threatens to reveal all his secrets to his crew if he doesn't give in to her demands. When Bianca and Cyril discover the despicable blackmail, they decide to take action to get the diary back.

BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E5 The Mark of the Rani: Part 1 People cannot sleep in the town of Killingworth and the Doctor realises it is the work of a renegade Time Lord, the Rani, who has teamed up with the Master to wreck chaos.

BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E6 The Mark of the Rani: Part 2 George Stephenson and Luke Ward do their best to help the Doctor and Peri, but the Rani has other traps for the unwary, including the ability to turn people into trees...

BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E23 The Twin Dilemma: Part 3 Mestor claims that all he wants is for the Sylvest twins to help him repopulate his home planet but the Doctor knows there’s more to this than meets the eye.

BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E24 The Twin Dilemma: Part 4 Mestor’s true plan is revealed and the Doctor's old Gallifreyan friend Azmael comes to the realisation that he has been corrupted long enough by the Gastropod leader.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Letters From Iwo Jima
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: As the Americans approach, the Japanese defenders dig deep into the volcanic earth of Iwo Jima. Some want to be heroes, others just want to see their wives.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Home Song Stories
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Rose, a glorious nightclub singer from Shanghai, struggles to survive in Australia with her two young children.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: What We Did on Our Holiday
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Doug and Abi travel to the Scottish Highlands with their three children to visit Doug's father for his birthday.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A British POW colonel orders his men to build and also sabotage a strategically important railway bridge for their Japanese captor in the Burmese jungle.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: King of My Castle
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Oligarch Jean-François is tired of his spoilt son Louis' behaviour and organises a scheme to make him believe that he has travelled back in time to the Russian Empire in 1860.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Legend of Fong Sai-Yuk
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A woman defends the family honour after her son, one of the best fighters in the locality, deliberately loses a fight with his beloved's mother.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Emu Runner
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Gem, a spirited young girl, deals with the grief of her mother's death by forming a bond with a wild emu.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Comic
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The story of a brilliant silent-film comic whose talent is overshadowed by his ego.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: L'arciere di fuoco
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Robin Hood and his Merry Men fight the evil Sheriff of Nottingham and Prince John to restore justice to the land.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: We Were Soldiers
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Lt Col Hal Moore, commander of the First Battalion, Seventh Cavalry, is assigned to action in the Drang Valley. Soon, he and his men are cornered in a tiny area by more than 2,000 Viet Cong, and engaged in a fight to the death.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Vera and the Pleasure of Others
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Vera, a 17-year-old student, rents out an empty flat in between her classes to teenagers who need a place to have sex. Her money-making venture eventually leads to Vera discovering her own desires.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: How to Get Ahead in Advertising
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A brilliant advertising executive develops a creative block and then grows a boil on his neck that develops into a second, talking head that takes him over.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Flags of Our Fathers
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Three of the six US servicemen, who raised that famous flag over Iwo Jima, are flown home to sell bonds for the US war machine.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: L'arciere di fuoco
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Robin Hood and his Merry Men fight the evil Sheriff of Nottingham and Prince John to restore justice to the land.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: U-96, The True Story of Das Boot
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The U-96 became one of the most popular submarines in cinema after the global success of the Das Boot film. The reality of the submarines is displayed with the help of interviews with the makers and actors, along with the last survivors of the era.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Eagle Huntress
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Aishol-pan, a 13-year-old girl, challenges tradition and gender barriers to become the first female in 12 generations of her Kazakh family to become an eagle hunter, a position handed down from father to son for centuries.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Finding Altamira
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A worldwide controversy is spread in 1879 when a Spanish archaeologist and his daughter discover cave paintings that are 10,000 years old.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Home Song Stories
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Rose, a glorious nightclub singer from Shanghai, struggles to survive in Australia with her two young children.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Queen of My Dreams
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Pakistani Muslim Mariam and her Canadian-born daughter, Azra, come of age in two different eras against the backdrop of a shared obsession with Bollywood fantasy.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: What We Did on Our Holiday
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Doug and Abi travel to the Scottish Highlands with their three children to visit Doug's father for his birthday.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In 19th-century France, a man takes his deaf and blind daughter to an institute where she may learn how to live and to communicate.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Spitfire
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In commemoration of the Royal Air Force's centenary, the history of the Spitfire aeroplane and the fighter pilots who helped win World War II's Battle of Britain is explored.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Sisu
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: During the last days of World War II, a solitary prospector crosses paths with Nazis on a scorched-earth retreat in northern Finland. When the soldiers decide to steal his gold, they quickly discover they just tangled with no ordinary miner.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 The Lost And Found Box After Debra-Jo loses her glasses the children take her to the Lost and Found box to look for them, where they discover all their long-lost own belongings.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Crookhaven ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Crooxeat Welcome to Crookhaven - where promising young crooks hone their deceptive talents for the greater good. Deception. Forgery. Crimnastics. Not your ordinary school curriculum.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark? ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E3 The Tale of the Phantom Light The Midnight Society seeks help from an unlikely source - the ghost of someone who may how the curse was created a generation earlier.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Secret Life Of Bees ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 Steve Backshall visits King Charles III's bees at Highgrove and gets some tips on how to look after his own bees from the King's own beekeeper, Steve Benbow.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mythbusters: There's Your Problem!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Electrical Friction Investigating three myths about electricity and three myths about friction, they test if you can be electrocuted by lightning while talking on the phone; if a stun-gun could use water instead of wires.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Chemicals This time The Slow Mo Guys go experimental and look at the amazing world of Chemicals. How amazing is Liquid Nitrogen, and what happens when you detonate it?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Robot Wars
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E5 Episode 5 This features one of the most bizarre but certainly the tallest robot ever seen on Robot Wars, Gabriel, built by Mensa member Craig and his three sons. It has wheels as tall as a washing machine and a huge samurai sword.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E17 A German Folk Song and an Actual Adult Georgie goes on a birthday date and Mary confronts Brenda about her relationship with George. Also, Sheldon takes an interest in Missy's favourite TV show.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BTN High ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E64 Social Media Ban Challenge Australia's social media ban is facing a legal challenge in the High Court. We take a look at the case and talk to an expert about its merits.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E31 A Six Pack Attack! When Professor Oak makes a surprise appearance in Hoenn, bringing along Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle, Ash joins forces with them to battle Team Rocket.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E42 A Chaotic Victory Party! Showdown At Last?! Monaka Vs. Goku! Bulma plans a victory party for all the fighters and wants to include Monaka. Beerus fears Goku will learn the truth of his newest rival and tries to keep him from going.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E5 Psycomedian A famous comedian gets akumatised into Psycomedian. Able to impose any emotions on anyone, he wants to wipe the smiles off everyone's faces...starting with Ladybug and Cat Noir!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E18 Road Trip Chloe and the Bears take a road trip to see a meteor shower.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E36 The Nom Nom Show Things go awry while Nom Nom shoots his first television show.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E29 Smile Bones Beast Boy and Cyborg try a new way of eating - no chewing!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E3 Brobots Cyborg comes to visit Beast Boy, but once Cyborg realizes how much he and Robotman have in common, they become inseparable.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E15 Manor and Mannerisms Robin attends a ball at Wayne Manor hoping to become heir of the mansion, but will the other Titans spoil his chances?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E2 The Doubloon Felicity and June learn about possible treasure at Malory Towers, while Darrell's leadership skills are put to the test organising a welcome party for the wayward First Formers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 Mad Tony: The Food Warrior Tony embarks on a pilgrimage to Sydney, Australia so he may indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs - Tetsuya Wakuda.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E8 Singapore: New York In Twenty Years Tony sets out to find the real Singapore, with its multicultural restaurants and food markets. He samples prescription food dishes and explores the Geyland Serai Marke.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E5 The Provincial French Picnic It's Easy Entertaining, and designer Jamie Durie and chef Annie Smithers join Adam for The Provincial French Picnic.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E5 Pheasant Learn how to butcher a whole pheasant and utilize the boneless meat for pheasant skewers basted with ginger juice and yakitori glaze.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E4 An Italian Lunchbox In Italy, a leisure lunch is just as important as dinner. Lidia shares ideas to make the American tradition more Italian; prosciutto cotto salad, cherry jam tart, and a scallion egg sandwich.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Cheeses Of Netherlands The Netherlands is the second largest exporter of cheese in Europe after France, yet it is famous for just two cheeses, Edam and Gouda, and Will is eager to sample them both.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E10 Beyond Blyde Canyon As the final stanza in Warren's Food Trail of South Africa, he's back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 Grasse As the world capital of perfume, Grasse opens the doors to its most treasured secrets.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Faroe Islands Situated north of Scotland, living on this collection of eighteen islands has always be a struggle for survival.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E2 Baked Turkey, Baked Kangaroo Sausage, Kangaroo Steaks With Bush Koonkaberry Sauce, Roo Tail Stew Time for some traditional inspired cooking. In this food adventure Ali and Mitch meet up with their cousin Ronnie Jimbidie at his tourism business Girlooloo Tours based at the spectacular Mimbi Caves.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E21 Planning Preparing for Christmas in June is not the norm for most of us, but for Maggie and Simon it's the ideal time to plan ahead and 'put down' some ingredients to mature nicely for the festive season.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E35 Episode 35 Laura is in the beautiful Adelaide Hills, cooking a very healthy and tasty Middle Eastern Cauliflower Salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E5 Speck & Saffron Carbonara With Stone Fruit Panzanella Rachael puts a bold spin on John's favourite Roman classic, Carbonara, by layering in the rich flavours of speck and a hint of saffron.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E4 Episode 4 One of Luca’s favourite ingredients takes the spotlight: Parmigiano Reggiano! This episode celebrates the king of cheeses with three dishes that showcase its savoury, nutty flavours.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Strait To The Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Kubin The people of Moa Island have always been farmers and gardeners and Aaron meets up with an old friend to learn how these traditions are being continued today.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E30 Episode 30 From the iconic fresh food markets, 2025 MasterChef winner Laura Sharrad hosts My Market Kitchen with loads of delicious recipes, plenty of guests and a few surprises.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Episode 10 Featuring Denis and Steve Moneghetti, Gary rounds out the season with lamb stracotto, a salad of Riverina fetta, green beans, Puy lentils and walnuts, and creamy chia pudding.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E5 The Provincial French Picnic It's Easy Entertaining, and designer Jamie Durie and chef Annie Smithers join Adam for The Provincial French Picnic.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigellissima: Italian Inspired Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Nigella Lawson creates a glamorous Italian-style Christmas buffet inspired by Venice, filled with festive breads, vibrant platters, and effortless holiday charm.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Berry Royal Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The Duchess of Cambridge and Mary will travel to Liverpool to visit The Brink the UK's first dry bar set up by Action on Addiction, that provides a safe space for people suffering from addiction.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Episode 10 Featuring Denis and Steve Moneghetti, Gary rounds out the season with lamb stracotto, a salad of Riverina fetta, green beans, Puy lentils and walnuts, and creamy chia pudding.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E59 Episode 59 Roasted Blueberries with Goat's Cheese Mousse and Steamed Egg Custard with Smoked Eel and Daikon are just some of the delicious recipes featured on today's episode of Everyday Gourmet.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Christchurch Sachie meets Kirsten Fox (an ex-lawyer turned food entrepreneur) at Riverside Kitchen. They wander the market and select key ingredients for the cook.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Auckland Henry Onesemo, head chef at Tala restaurant, grew up in Samoa. His passion for food started when he was young. The Samoan word tala means story or tale.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marcus In The Med: Mallorca
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Veggie Days You don't have to go far in Mallorca to discover an abundance of locally grown fruit and veg, and Marcus is celebrating it all with a visit to local beach restaurant Patiki.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Feast By Fire
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Breaking The Cut In Austin, Jess visits Leroy and Lewis Barbecue, where lesser-known cuts like top blade are given the spotlight.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Thai Street Food: Best Kept Secrets
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Roots Of Thai Fire From a mother and daughter dumpling shop, to hand-made hill-tribe snacks, these spicy & savoury street food snacks expose the roots and global influences that have shaped the Thai food we know today.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Global Soul Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Barbecue Salmon & Zupa Ogorkowa Chef Deborah VanTrece creates a flavourful party menu featuring Zupa Ogorkowa, a Polish dill pickle chowder, and Kansas City-style barbecue salmon with biscuits.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Remarkable Places To Eat
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Puglia TV and radio host, Dermot O'Leary takes Fred Sirieix to Puglia in Italy's deep South to his favourite restaurants showcasing simple but sublime cucina povera, or poor man's cooking.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Flying Fish Five months on the new Sydney Fish Market faces its greatest test: a bleak winter and shrinking seafood supply. From crocodile waters to the Chatham Islands, fishers and merchants battle distance.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Malaysia And Sri Lanka Rick is spoilt for choice as he explores the multi-faceted food of Penang, an appealing mix of Malay, Indian and Chinese with a bit of British charm thrown in for good measure.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E6 A Royal Taste Of Jordan Gordon digs deep into the verdant north and arid south of Jordan to discover rich, fresh flavours as he prepares to impress royalty at Petra.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Gozo Ainsley heads to the idyllic island of Gozo to finish his journey, starting with a picturesque picnic filled with the tastes of Malta courtesy of Ana.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 The Ass Crack Of Dawn In New York City It's last call and you're hungry. What do you do? Luckily, you're in New York City, where your crew can choose from mouth-watering options like Korean BBQ, empanadas, and birria.

Each episode features Peterson traveling to a farm machinery auction, where he meets some of the people who attend the sales where items like tractors and skid steers are sold. He also provides his analysis of current and historical trends in the used equipment market and answers viewer questions about what their equipment is worth in the Ask Machinery Pete segment. 5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Batman Forever
5starmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
5starmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

5starmax.us.title: Repo Men
5starmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
5starmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
5starmax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: A filmmaking crew (Heather Donahue, Michael C. Williams, Joshua Leonard) hikes into Maryland's Black Hills Forest seeking clues about a legendary witch. - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: When a townie takes collegians on an overnight tour in Burkittsville, Md., they awake to chaos and have no memory of sleeping. - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Time Bandits
5starmax.us.description: Cosmic dwarfs take a boy on an odyssey featuring Robin Hood (John Cleese), Napoleon, King Agamemnon (Sean Connery). - 1981

5starmax.us.title: Lord of the Flies
5starmax.us.description: English schoolboys (James Aubrey, Tom Chapin, Hugh Edwards), stranded on a desert island without adults, soon turn savage. - 1963

5starmax.us.title: Working Girls
5starmax.us.description: A photographer (Louise Smith) and others work for a yuppie madam (Ellen McElduff) in a Manhattan brothel, then go home. - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Blood Simple
5starmax.us.description: Complications arise when the owner of a Texas bar pays a man (M. Emmet Walsh) to kill his wife (Frances McDormand) and her lover (John Getz). - 1984

5starmax.us.title: Despicable Me
5starmax.us.description: As he tries to execute a fiendish plot to steal the moon, a supervillain meets his match in three little orphan girls who want to make him their dad. - 2010

5starmax.us.title: A Hard Day's Night
5starmax.us.description: John, Paul, George and Ringo (The Beatles) spend 36 wild hours in London, besieged by exuberant fans. - 1964

5starmax.us.title: Mississippi Masala
5starmax.us.description: People resent the romance of a black man (Denzel Washington) and an Indian woman (Sarita Choudhury) in a Mississippi town. - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: Agent Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) comes to Twin Peaks, Wash., following two unresolved murders and the disappearance of two fellow agents. - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
5starmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean organizes a gang to steal $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos in a single heist. - 2001

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
5starmax.us.description: To pay back casino boss Terry Benedict, Danny Ocean and his team of criminals plan an elaborate heist in Europe. - 2004

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

5starmax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
5starmax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
5starmax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: MacGruber
5starmax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Night on Earth
5starmax.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy drama, Drama) - 1992

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.
