buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: Card Sharks
buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24

cinevault.us.description: Frustrated with a soul-killing job, New Yorker Julie Powell embarks on a daring project: she vows to prepare all 524 recipes in Julia Child's landmark cookbook, "Mastering the Art of French Cooking." Intertwined with Julie's story is the true tale of how Julia Child herself conquered French cuisine with passion, fearlessness, and plenty of butter. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 2009-08-07

cinevault.us.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
cinevault.us.description: Following a childhood tragedy, Dewey Cox (John C. Reilly) follows a long and winding road to music stardom. Dewey perseveres through changing musical styles, an addiction to nearly every drug known and bouts of uncontrollable rage, until finally, he wins the heart, but not necessarily the body, of his loyal backup singer, Darlene (Jenna Fischer). (Comedy, Movie, Musical comedy) - 2007

cinevault.us.title: She's Out of Control
cinevault.us.description: A Los Angeles radio-station manager's (Tony Danza) girlfriend (Catherine Hicks) shows his teenage daughter (Ami Dolenz) how to be sexy. (Comedy, Movie) - 1989-04-14

cinevault.us.title: The River Murders
cinevault.us.description: A homicide detective investigating a series of murders becomes the prime suspect when the FBI uncovers his close ties to all the victims. (Movie, Thriller) - 2011-07-01

cinevault.us.title: Red Water
cinevault.us.description: Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water. (Movie, Thriller) - 2003-08-17

cinevault.us.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
cinevault.us.description: Bill Johnson leads a group of scientists into the jungles of Borneo. They are searching for the mythical black orchid, which can supposedly grant eternal life. Unfortunately, massive anacondas have been feeding on the orchids for years. When their boat goes over a waterfall, the scientists land right in the middle of the snakes' home. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-08-27

cinevault.us.title: Maximum Risk
cinevault.us.description: French police officer Alain Moreau makes an astonishing discovery: Mikhail, a man who died recently in a breakneck car chase, is the twin brother he never knew. Alain then uncovers a web of family secrets that lead him to New York City, where his brother was involved with the Russian Mafia. Teaming up with Mikhail's lover, Alex Minetti, Alain must now assume his twin's identity and go undercover to avenge Mikhail's death. (Action, Movie) - 1996

cinevault.us.title: Bad Country
cinevault.us.description: After arresting a contract killer, a Louisiana detective tries to convince him to become an informant in an attempt to bring down the South's most powerful criminal organization. (Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2014

cinevault.us.title: Takers
cinevault.us.description: Gordon Jennings (Idris Elba) and his friends enjoy a luxurious lifestyle funded by bank robberies, and they avoid capture by sticking to a strict set of rules. As they celebrate the latest job, a former associate arrives with a daring plan to rob an armored car. The lure of so much cash is too tempting to resist but, unbeknown to Gordon's men, this heist puts them on a collision course with Russian mobsters and a detective (Matt Dillon) who will do anything to capture them. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-08-27

cinevault.us.title: The Tourist
cinevault.us.description: During an impromptu trip to Europe to mend a broken heart, math teacher Frank Tupelo (Johnny Depp) finds himself in an extraordinary situation when an alluring stranger, Elise (Angelina Jolie), places herself in his path. Their seemingly innocent flirtation turns into a dangerous game of cat and mouse while various people, who all think that Frank is Elise's thieving paramour, Alexander Pearce, try to capture the pair. (Action, Movie, Romance, Thriller) - 2010-12-09

cinevault.us.title: 28 Days
cinevault.us.description: The story of Gwen Cummings (Sandra Bullock), a successful New York writer living in the fast lane and everyone's favorite party girl -- until she gets drunk with boyfriend Jasper (Dominic West), borrows her sister's (Elizabeth Perkins) wedding limo and earns herself a stay in court-ordered rehab. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 2000-02-08

cinevault.us.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
cinevault.us.description: Following a childhood tragedy, Dewey Cox (John C. Reilly) follows a long and winding road to music stardom. Dewey perseveres through changing musical styles, an addiction to nearly every drug known and bouts of uncontrollable rage, until finally, he wins the heart, but not necessarily the body, of his loyal backup singer, Darlene (Jenna Fischer). (Comedy, Movie, Musical comedy) - 2007

cinevault.us.title: That's My Boy
cinevault.us.description: While still a teen himself, Donny (Adam Sandler) fathered a son, Todd (Andy Samberg), and raised him as a single parent. On Todd's 18th birthday, Donny cut the youth loose. After years of estrangement, the older man shows up unexpectedly on the eve of his son's wedding day, sending the young man's life into a tailspin. Donny wants desperately to reconnect with Todd, but he must now deal with the repercussions of the bad parenting he exhibited in the past. (Comedy, Movie) - 2012-06-15

cinevault.us.title: Stealing Harvard
cinevault.us.description: John (Jason Lee) is a hard-working guy who only wants to marry his longtime girlfriend Elaine (Leslie Mann). Elaine and John have vowed to marry once they save $30,000 for their dream house. Things are fine until John's sister calls to remind him of his promise to pay his niece's tuition, which costs $29,829 and is due in two weeks! John turns to his friend Duff (Tom Green) to help him make $30,000 quickly. Duff convinces John to make a short-term commitment to petty crime. (Comedy, Movie) - 2002-09-13

cinevault.us.title: Wild America
cinevault.us.description: The fearless young Stouffer brothers -- Marty (Scott Bairstow), Mark (Devon Sawa) and Marshall (Jonathan Taylor Thomas) -- can hardly imagine going into the family business hawking auto parts in small-town Arkansas. With the begrudging approval of their no-nonsense father, the brothers set out on a dangerous cross-country camping trip, intending to capture on film their encounters with wild animals and the last remnants of the natural world in the rapidly vanishing American West. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1997-07-02

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Leticia Riddle vs. Jay White

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Lakeysla \"Keisha\" Williams vs. Brian \"Champ\" Harmon
divorcecourt.us.description: Keisha says Champ's excessive flirting is ruining the trust in their marriage; he says that, as a rapper and television producer, it pays to have a big personality, and she needs to control her jealousy. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-28

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ieisha Shingles vs. Quan Porter

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Valerie Bossett vs. Toya Gonzales

(Reality, Law) - 2022-02-01

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Jasmine Allen vs. Chance Shelton
divorcecourt.us.description: Jasmine says boyfriend Chance spends too much time at the studio and may have gotten another woman pregnant; she has invested $20,000 in his music business but hasn't seen a return; he accuses her of spending time with another man. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-02

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Brandon Benson vs. Nicole Lara
divorcecourt.us.description: Brandon says his girlfriend, Nicole, is obsessed with going viral and isn't focused on her career goals; he says they are just too different, and it's best they go their separate ways. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-03

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Brandon Benson vs. Nicole Lara
divorcecourt.us.description: Nicole says she desperately wants to save her relationship with Brandon, but her goal is to go viral with her social media videos to make money. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-04

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Theresa Connors vs. Mark Haynes
divorcecourt.us.description: Theresa says her fiancé, Mark, is a sex and porn addict who spent half of their wedding budget on his addiction; he says he wants to save his relationship, but he believes she is overreacting and he doesn't have a problem. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-07

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Demetria George vs. Tyrone Faison
divorcecourt.us.description: Demetria says Tyrone wants to be in control of every aspect of her career as a stand-up comic, including who she talks to and where she performs; Tyrone says that, as the man, he wants to be respected. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-08

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - David Irvin vs. Hillary Barlow

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ashlei Edwards vs. Keenann Spencer
divorcecourt.us.description: Ashley says Keenan made good money in the beginning of their relationship, then he quit his job and missed rent payments; he says she is controlling, has a military background, and tells him to do things around the house, instead of asking. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-10

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Seankeithius \"Kwaun\" Porter vs. Kamry Ukpai
divorcecourt.us.description: Kamry thinks spending all the time together is key to a successful relationship, but Kwaun says he is starting to feel smothered -- she even shows up at his workplace and refuses to leave; she says he needs to make her a priority. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-11

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Angelica Demello vs. James Maria
divorcecourt.us.description: Angelica says she cleans the house, acts as the handyman, and manages the finances, and James needs to contribute more financially and step up as the man of the house, or she will not marry him; he counters that she has a bad drinking problem. divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Nina Ruffini vs. Minori Hinds
divorcecourt.us.description: Nina says she is sick of her girlfriend, Minori, hiding their relationship and spending her money, and she doesn't feel appreciated; Minori says she has struggled with coming out of the closet and presses Nina to wait until she's ready. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-15

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tajanea Polk vs. Joe Cambridge

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tajanea Polk vs. Joe Cambridge

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Chasity Evans vs. Wesley Clement

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Judith Garrett vs. Andre Rodriguez

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Raymond Bentley vs. Janteba Bentley

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Angela Dewey vs. Delbert Dewey

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Pamela Edwards vs. Lauren Edwards

fifthgear.us.description: S09 E01 Jason Plato helps a lottery winner choose a new supercar; Tiff Needell road tests the new Jaguar XK on the best road in the world; Tom Ford meets Jenson Button at the Geneva Motor Show.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E02 A crash test between a Land Rover Discovery and a Renault Espace evaluates safety differences between four-by-four vehicles and multipurpose vehicles.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson is the only British journalist invited to test drive Ferrari's new race car, the F430 Challenge; Tom Ford takes an exclusive one-off look into the secret world of the Maybach.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E04 A look at America's most glamorous car club, based in an underground bunker; Tiff and Jason race the BMW M3 against the Audi RS4.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E05 We reveal the Best Cheap Car in Britain, meet the man who's giving away a free Ferrari to try and help sell his house, and a look round the country's ultimate supercar collection.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E06 Jason Plato teaches Girls Aloud how to become racing drivers; Tiff Needell drives the new Maserati Quattroporte, and Tom Ford tries to break the world record for doing donuts in a car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E07 Vicki Butler-Henderson learns how to become a spy photographer as she goes undercover trying to snap car manufacturer's secret prototypes; Tom Ford is in Japan driving the car of the future.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E08 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out exactly how well built a Mercedes is when she crashes it, drowns it in a flood and then drives over it in a monster truck.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E09 Find out what happens if you accidentally put diesel into a petrol engine; follow Tiff Needell as he races an Aston Martin DBR9S.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E10 Tiff Needell and Tom Ford test the new Citroën C6 by recreating the President de Gaulle assassination attempt with professional gunmen.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E11 Tom Ford flies out on Alan Sugar's private jet to test the brand new Audi TT, Vicki Butler-Henderson attempts a new land speed record, and Tiff Needell enters the inaugural D1GB drifting competition.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E12 Jason Plato tests the new 911 Turbo, Vicki Butler-Henderson presents a high speed crash test, and Tom Ford drives a new Lamborghini.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E13 We bring you the supercar battle when we pitch the McLaren F1 against the Enzo Ferrari; Jason Plato tries his hand at flying a stunt plane.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E01 "Fifth Gear" quite literally takes to new heights by staging a race between cars and planes.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E02 Tom Ford is testing the opulent £225,000 Bentley Azure with some help from film director Michael Winner; Jonny Smith tries to drive coast-to-coast using chip fat as fuel.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the Lotus Elise S is the best track car for novices; Le Mans winner Guy Smith races the fastest van on sale today.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E04 Jon Bentley investigates how hitting a motorway crash barrier can make your car fly through the air. Jason Plato gives cricketer Kevin Pietersen the chance to drive the Lamborghini Gallardo Spyder.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E05 Jason drives the impressive 500bhp Ford Shelby GT500; Tiff races Mitsubishi's Evo 9 FQ360 against a former Red Arrow pilot's stunt plane.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson drives the one-off supercharged Nissan Murano GTC; Jonny Smith challenges the big lawnmower to a head to head in a grass cutting contest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E07 Jason drives the Subaru Litchfield Type 25; Tiff drives the Ferrari 599 on the world's most treacherous roads.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E08 Tom Ford drives Volvo's stylish new coupe, the C30; Tiff Needell tests whether a green supercar really can be fun in Lotus' biofuel powered Exige 265E.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson has a mini-moto race against some of the big names in bike racing; Tom Ford tests the new Land Rover Freelander on Britain's remote school run.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E10 Tom Ford's been testing the Mazda's new MX5 Roadster Coupe; Vicki Butler-Henderson has been thrashing Porsche's 911 GT3.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E11 Vicki is taught how to drive a car on two wheels; Jonny visits Germany for some extreme airbag testing.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E12 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if an old Daihatsu Charade is the toughest car you can buy; Tom Ford drives the Honda CRV, the SUV that claims to be greener than a Mini Cooper.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E13 The winners of the Fifth Gear Awards 2006; prizes for Best Small Car, Best Family Car, Best Fast Car and the overall Car of the Year.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E01 Vicki Butler-Henderson takes the new Fiat Panda 100HP for a spin around the track - against a Ferrari; Tiff Needell hits Las Vegas to try out Audi's first supercar, the R8.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E02 Vicki Butler-Henderson risks life and limb in the most dangerous car stunt of all, driving a car under a moving lorry; Jonny Smith tests the new Mercedes C Class and its revolutionary seat design.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E03 Tiff Needell employs the help of two models to test the theory that the quicker you drive a convertible, the less your hair blows. He blasts the brand new Bentley Continental GTC up to 150mph.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E04 Vicki Butler-Henderson makes an unprecedented attempt to hit 200mph in an A1 Grand Prix car; Tom Ford and Jonny Smith take the seven newest hot hatches on sale and decide which is best.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E05 Jonny Smith goes on a rather expensive road trip - in a £250,000 Rolls-Royce Phantom; Tom Ford is testing the new Porsche Cayenne Turbo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E06 Jason drives the Aston Martin V8 Vantage Roadster, Jonny tests the car James Bond drove in Casino Royale.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E07 Tom Ford tests the latest version of the car that is perennially voted one of Britain's favourite cars - the Land Rover Defender; Jonny Smith celebrates Ferrari's 60th Birthday.

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Arlington Road
filmriseaction.us.description: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 1999

filmriseaction.us.title: JCVD
filmriseaction.us.description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery. (Comedy, Crime drama, Action) - 2008

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city. (Action, Drama, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: A man (John Cusack) and his young son (Jamie Anderson) encounter an assassin (Morgan Freeman) while hiking in a forest. - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: Cops and convicts join forces to defend a barren police station from a vengeance-seeking street gang. - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: Dillinger and Capone
filmriseaction.us.description: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist. - 1995

filmriseaction.us.title: Guns of Redemption
filmriseaction.us.description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel. - 2025

filmriseaction.us.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
filmriseaction.us.description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town. - 2023

filmriseaction.us.title: Blitz
filmriseaction.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. - 2011

filmriseaction.us.title: The 51st State
filmriseaction.us.description: A chemist (Samuel L. Jackson) who produces illegal drugs travels to Liverpool, England, to negotiate one last deal before he retires. - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Survivor
filmriseaction.us.description: Framed for a terrorist bombing, a foreign service officer (Milla Jovovich) must dodge a top assassin (Pierce Brosnan), while racing against time to thwart a deadly plot. - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife. He is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt warden, the facility holds brutal fights between inmates. - 2003

filmriseaction.us.title: Stolen
filmriseaction.us.description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab. - 2012

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. - 1998

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: The Final Stand
filmriseaction.us.description: The story of the Podolsk cadets in October 1941 near Moscow during WWII, where the cadets of the Podolsk artillery-infantry schools receive orders to take up defenses on the Ilyinsky line. (Action, Drama, War) - 2020

filmriseaction.us.title: Agent Red
filmriseaction.us.description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed
filmriseaction.us.description: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza
filmriseaction.us.description: An undercover FBI agent has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI. (Crime drama) - 1993

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You
filmriseaction.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (Action, Drama) - 2022

Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

network.us.description: A family friend asks Herrmann for some advice on opening a bar; tensions run high between Emma and Violet; Kidd struggles to keep her team together. (Drama)

network.us.description: Mouch and Ritter work together to solve a murder mystery; Severide and Cruz tackle a food truck fire; Gallo goes to see Hawkins about Violet. (Drama)

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S16 E08 Window Gap; Solar Drinking Water Roger teaches how to care for orchids; Tom fixes a window that was not hung properly and is now letting air in; Mark demonstrates how to clean brick with acid; in Future House, Ross finds a solar panel that can generate drinking water from thin air.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S16 E09 Walkway Reset; Chipped Floor Roger teaches his apprentice how to not only repair a damaged walkway, but also how to identify what caused the damage so it can be prevented in the future; Tom patches a chipped wood floor using a Dutchman and hand tools.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S16 E10 Jimmy DiResta; Wobbly Toilet Mark tests out different tools that collect silica dust more efficiently; Richard shims a wobbly toilet; Kevin heads to the Catskills to build a wooden slice table with Jimmy DiResta, a maker who's known for his online how-to videos.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

700407.title: Garden Rescue

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

700407.title: Gardeners' World

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. 700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty and team share the best practical gardening advice, meet passionate plants-people up and down the country, and provide inspiration with visits to some of the UK's most remarkable gardens.

700407.title: Gardeners' World

700407.title: Garden Rescue

Adam Frost visits the RHS garden Wisley where he meets the Curator to discuss the effects of summer. 700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.

classica.us.title: Schumann - 2. Klaviersonate in g-Moll, op. 22
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Klaviersonate Nr. 2 in g-Moll, Op. 22. Es beginnt mit einem energischen ersten Satz, gefolgt von einem wunderschönen, langsamen Andantino nach Schumanns Lied "Im Herbste". (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-09

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - 3. Sinfonie, op. 78
classica.us.description: Das Philharmonische Orchester Rotterdam spielte unter der Leitung von Conrad van Alphen am 20. Oktober 2018 in Rotterdam Saint-Saëns' 3. Sinfonie. Sie trägt den Beinamen "Orgelsinfonie", da dieses Instrument im zweiten und vierten Satz zu hören ist. (Special, Event, Music) - 2019-04-06

classica.us.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
classica.us.description: Ein beeindruckendes Konzerterlebnis, das mit einer Mischung aus spektakulären Sound- und Lichteffekten eine ganz besondere Atmosphäre schafft. Mit der Unterstützung eines Chors werden verschiedene Filmmusikstücke komplett neu vertont. (Music, Concert) - 2020

classica.us.title: Danielpour - Elegies
classica.us.description: Hartmut Haenchen leitet das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland in einem Konzert von Richard Danielpours "Elegies". Solisten sind Marina Prudenskaya und Thomas Oliemans. Die Aufnahme entstand 2019 im Muziekgebouw Eindhoven in den Niederlanden. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-04-04

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-15

classica.us.title: Welser-Möst dirigiert Farrenc & Mussorgsky/Ravel
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester mit einem Programm, das im März 2023 im Severance Music Center in Cleveland aufgezeichnet wurde. Auf dem Programm sind Louise Farrencs Sinfonie Nr. 3, Ravels Klavierkonzert in G-Dur mit Víkingur. (Special) - 2026-05-23

classica.us.title: Donizetti - Lucia di Lammermoor
classica.us.description: Die italienische Dirigentin Speranza Scappucci leitet die Philharmonia Zürich und den Chor des Opernhauses Zürich bei einer Aufführung von Gaetano Donizettis tragischer Oper "Lucia di Lammermoor" aus dem Jahr 1835. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-06-23

classica.us.title: Le Grand Orgue in Concert
classica.us.description: Olivier Latry, der Titularorganist der großen Orgel der Pariser Kathedrale Notre-Dame, verzaubert mit einer meisterhaften Performance an der historischen Orgel der Kathedrale. Das Konzert entstand 2015 unter der Regie von Noëlle Louisor. (Special, Music, Documentary) - 2019-05-07

classica.us.title: Hans van Manen: Moving to Music
classica.us.description: Reflexionen von Freunden und Kollegen, die Details der Choreographie von Hans van Manen enthüllen.

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - 2. Sinfonie, op. 17
classica.us.description: Das London Symphony Orchestra spielt unter der Leitung des Amerikaners Michael Tilson Thomas Tschaikowskys Symphonie Nr. 2 in c-Moll. Die Symphonie trägt auch den Spitznamen "Kleinrussische", da ukrainische Volkslieder mit einflossen.

classica.us.title: Schumann: Humoreske, Op. 20
classica.us.description: In der Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz die Humoreske in B-Dur, Op. 20. Schumann komponierte das Werk im Jahr 1839 und widmete es Julie von Webenau. Der Titel des Werks bezieht sich auf die ältere Bedeutung von Humor als emotionaler Zustand.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight

classica.us.title: Bach - Präludien und Fugen & Alla variata BWV 989
Werke für Cello und Klavier von Schumann u.a
classica.us.description: In Genf, der Stadt, in der sie den größten Teil ihres Lebens verbrachte, lädt die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich ihren langjährigen Musikpartner, den Cellisten Mischa Maisky, zu einem privaten Kammermusikkonzert ein.

classica.us.title: Bach-Konzert & Mendelssohn-Sinfonie Nr. 4
classica.us.description: Sir András Schiff leitet das Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet der Hochschule für Musik Reina Sofía. Auf dem Programm steht Bachs Konzert für Cembalo Nr. 5 in f-Moll, BWV 1056 sowie Mendelssohns Sinfonie Nr. 4 in A-Dur, Op. 90, die Italienische.

classica.us.title: Ravel - La Valse

outlaw.us.title: The Cowboys
outlaw.us.description: A grizzled veteran rancher, Wil Andersen (John Wayne) is almost ready to embark on a big cattle drive when his crew abruptly quits to join in a gold rush. Left with no alternative, Anderson enlists the help of a group of local schoolboys. Training the youngsters to be cowboys, Andersen manages to get the drive underway, but their long journey is placed in jeopardy when the devious bandit Long Hair (Bruce Dern) sets his sights on stealing the herd. (Western) - 1972

outlaw.us.title: The Train Robbers

outlaw.us.title: Wild Stallion

outlaw.us.title: The Big Trees
outlaw.us.description: Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone, including settler Elder Bixby; his beautiful daughter, Alicia; Fallon's fair-minded employee, Yukon Burn; and his right-hand man, Frenchy LeCroix -- and his cheating ways create unlikely bedfellows. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: The Hanging Tree
outlaw.us.description: Joseph "Doc" Frail (Gary Cooper) is a doctor with a past he's trying to outrun. While in Montana, he comes across a mining camp with a hanging tree and rescues a man named Rune (Ben Piazza) from the noose. With Rune as his servant, Frail decides to settle down, and he takes over as town doctor. He meets Elizabeth (Maria Schell), who is suffering from shock, and the two soon fall in love. But when Elizabeth is attacked, Frail's attempt to help her land them both in trouble. (Western) - 1959

outlaw.us.title: Springfield Rifle

outlaw.us.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell

outtvproud.us.title: Frankenstein
outtvproud.us.description: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist. (Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2004

outtvproud.us.description: In 1892 Lizzie Borden lives a quiet life in Massachusetts under the strict rules established by her father. outtvproud.us.title: Backtrack
outtvproud.us.description: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1989

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Italian Alps Comfort Food

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

thechallenge.us.description: S02 E06 A Whole New World A surprise twist from TJ changes the entire game; a former champion must test his resolve against an intimidating opponent; an All-Star conquers a fear only to have their season thrown into jeopardy.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: All Stars
thechallenge.us.description: S02 E07 Save the Palace Friends on opposite alliances have their relationship put to the test; the All-Stars face their fears at an adrenaline-pumping challenge; one player harbors a huge secret from the house.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: All Stars
thechallenge.us.description: S02 E08 (You Drive Me) Crazy The theft of a Greek salad ignites a massive blow up that could cost one All-Star their game; TJ's mini-Final puts partnerships to the test; one pair contemplates a savage game move.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: All Stars
thechallenge.us.description: S02 E09 Break Stuff The game reaches a fever pitch as the All-Stars scramble to survive the last challenge before the final; a moment of rage puts a power player's season in jeopardy; an injury could cost one pair their shot at redemption.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: All Stars
thechallenge.us.description: S02 E10 It Takes Two In the stifling Yucatan jungle, the final four pairs test the relationships they've built and are pushed to their physical, mental, and emotional limits as they race towards the prize.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: All Stars
thechallenge.us.description: S03 E01 An All Star Is Born Twenty-four Challenge All Stars, all finalists or winners, arrive in Panama to face off; all eyes are on the notorious Wes and Veronica as they leave both their enemies and friends wondering what trouble they have in store.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: All Stars
thechallenge.us.description: S03 E02 You've Been Sabotaged! An added twist in the game, the sabotage, is in play and the All Stars nervously wonder which players will fall victim to it; the "Out Of Reach" challenge leaves some players all wet and others breaking down; legendary rematches in the arena.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: All Stars
thechallenge.us.description: S03 E03 Treehouse of Horror The gloves and clothes are off at the muddy "Playing Dirty" challenge; the newly formed Treehouse alliance makes major moves to crush players who stand in their way; a pair of shocking surprises threaten to completely change the game.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: All Stars
thechallenge.us.description: S03 E04 She's Back! TJ surprises the challengers with a blast from the past and a new rivalry is born; the high-altitude "High Stakes" challenge leaves some players flying high, and others crashing down.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: All Stars
thechallenge.us.description: S03 E05 More Than Friends? Lines are drawn at the "Sidetracked" challenge after several All-Stars team up to target their biggest competition; two players are shocked to find themselves on everyone's radar when a notorious veteran accuses them of being more than just allies.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge: All Stars
thechallenge.us.description: S03 E06 Revenge Of The All Stars Several All Stars look to make big moves to change up the balance of power in the house; the grueling "Stacked" challenge pushes the challengers to their limits and keeps the heat on a pair of boiling rivalries.

Lessons include making marinara sauce with four ingredients, butchering a beef tenderloin, cooking chicken breasts in parchment paper and how to determine which meats are good for braising. 400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: He wandered the streets of New York City wearing only pajamas and a bathrobe, but the FBI was convinced that Vince Gigante, the reputed boss of the Genovese crime family, was anything but crazy. The FBI used undercover surveillance, secret audio tapes, six mobsters turned government informants and the testimony of twelve FBI agents to help convict Gigante of murder and conspiracy-to-murder, including a plot to kill rival mob boss John Gotti.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: The rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984 had the authorities puzzled and the community scared. Since the beginning, the FBI had been analyzing the crime scene evidence and had found a common link: red trilobal carpet fibers. But there was no suspect, until one of the killer's potential victims survived. Through her interviews and the cooperation of local authorities and the FBI, 31-year-old Bobby Joe Long emerged as the prime suspect.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Claude Dallas lived the life of a cowboy. A loner and distrustful of authority, he lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides. But when two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed. After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted, only to escape months later. Making the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded the law for almost a year until the FBI tracked him down in a small town in California.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: He was a recluse who spread terror through the mail for 18 years. Two men died and more than a dozen were injured, but Ted Kaczynski wasn't known as the Unabomber until his brother tipped off the FBI. Kaczynski's “Unabomber Manifesto,” published in major newspapers, set off a flurry of activity for the FBI: writing analysis and comparisons, DNA gleaned from a single postage stamp and finally, Kaczynski's arrest at his tiny cabin.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared from a Christmas party in December 1989, the only probable suspect was 24-year-old Caleb Hughes. Hughes reportedly left the party around the time Melissa vanished, but no one saw him with the girl. Fifty blue acrylic fibers collected during a search of Hughes' car, however, became the major piece of evidence in the case. FBI fiber analysis determined that those fibers were identical to the ones that made up the sweater Melissa was wearing.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 26, 1993, an explosion rocked the World Trade Center parking garage. Six people died and more than a thousand were injured in the bomb blast that tore a 5-story crater in the building. During the investigation, the twisted fender of a rental van was extracted from the rubble. The FBI was able to determine from where the van was rented and by whom. Undercover agents then made their arrests within six days of the bombing.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By December 1985, John Gotti had assumed his place as the new Don of the Gambino crime family in New York with the assassination of his boss, Paul Castellano. The Teflon Don felt secure in his position, always remaining one step ahead of the law. But he was also the ongoing obsession of Bruce Mouw, leader of an elite crew of FBI agents formed to bring down the Gambino family. With the help and genius of his Special Projects Squad, bugs were planted in Gotti's most private meeting places.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer. Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune. Most ended up dead. As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage. The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program. The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Larry Horn nearly got away with the perfect crime: a multiple murder-for-hire plot that was meticulously planned and executed. Horn's former wife, their 8-year-old son, and a live-in nurse were all brutally murdered by an assassin. In the absence of any significant clues, police in Maryland contacted the FBI to assist in the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A cunning predator was loose in rural South Carolinaabducting young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was also a sadist, calling one victim's family, taunting them, boosting and then dashing their hopes. Local investigators called on the FBI to help them find this clever serial killer. Like a game of chess, FBI profilers and forensic examiners were able to outwit the killer, and put an end to his deadly game of cat and mouse.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a young boy and his mother were kidnapped and murdered by a vicious drug cartel, FBI agents in the field worked tirelessly to pierce the secretive drug underworld and unearth those involved. Their surveillance and investigative work uncovered a violent trail of murder and greed. FBI agents and forensic examiners pieced together the evidence needed to draw out and then crush the cartel.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Local law enforcement became stumped when the body of an unidentified young woman turned up on a highway in their small Pennsylvania town. They turned to the FBI labs. The hi-tech lab enabled investigators and agents to identify the victim. Knowing who she was allowed agents to reconstruct her every move. Though the road to finding her killer was twisted and long, agents persisted.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A serial killer's rampage was discovered when the bodies of several young women began turning up in shallow graves that dotted the Alaskan wilderness. The killer taunted his victims, hunting them like animals before shooting them down. He was at home in the rugged terrain. But the hunt for him began 3000 miles away, where FBI profilers mapped the criminal's mind.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a judge and his politician wife were brutally murdered in their home. The killer left few clues and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI was patiently waiting in the wings. Once it was determined that federal laws had been violated, they pounced on the investigation. They uncovered a corrupt local government and a group of violent criminal conspirators known as the Dixie Mafia, responsible for fraud, money laundering and murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Corruption in the New Orleans Police Department grew like a cancer in the early 1990's. Lured by the easy wealth of the narcotics industry, crooked cops began breaking the laws they were sworn to uphold. They would stop at nothing, including murder, to protect their rackets. When it became clear they could no longer police themselves, the FBI got involved. Putting their lives on the line, undercover agents devised a way to flush out the violent cops and restore trust in the city's police force.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Residents of the small town of Noel, Missouri were shocked when one of their banks was robbed. When the bank president was nowhere to be found, the residents were outraged. The FBI discovered that things are not always as they appear. Minute clues led the agents to the body of the bank president. With no suspects, the FBI relied on dogged determination and modern forensics. Agents slowly pieced together tiny shreds of evidence.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: From May until July of 1984, Alton Coleman and his common law wife, Denise Brown, engaged in a gruesome crime spree that spanned six states and left eight people dead including children. The FBI coordinated law enforcement efforts throughout the entire country in order to track the couple. Their expertise in conducting manhunts for the nation's most horrible killers paid off. The couple was located and apprehended as they prepared to kill again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home. The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed. Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child. Both had been murdered. Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car. The hair was too small for analysis.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1980, the FBI began a massive undercover operation, code named Safebet, that was designed to expose the Chicago Mafia's infiltration into the city's surrounding suburbs. Undercover agents quickly discovered that the mob had its tentacles spread into every facet of the law enforcement community. They unwittingly uncovered the murder of a wealthy socialite perpetrated by a jealous and greedy mob lawyer and covered up by the local police chief.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation. With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators. On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies. They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car. What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Beginning in summer of 1990, the bodies of several women began turning up in and around the city of Vienna, Austria. From an extensive investigation by the Viennese police, it was determined that these murders were the work of one sadistic predator. Europe was dealing with a serial killer. With no experience with this kind of predator, Viennese police turned to the FBI. FBI profilers were able to identify a suspect in the murders. More ominously, they linked this same killer to murders committed in the United States.

673500.title: The Magic Carpet
673500.description: When his parents, the caliph and queen, are murdered by usurper Ali (Gregory Gaye), the newborn Ramoth is delivered to the safety of his uncle, Ahkmid (William Fawcett), via a magic carpet. The adult Ramoth (John Agar) becomes masked hero the Scarlet Falcon. After tricking the reigning caliph into appointing him the royal physician, Ramoth learns of his noble birth and, with the help of faithful Razi (George Tobias) and beautiful Lida (Patricia Medina), he fights Ali and his wrathful minions.

673500.title: The Game That Kills
673500.description: A man infiltrates a hockey team to investigate the death of his brother, the team's star left wing.

673500.title: The Big Heat
673500.description: A police officer seems to have committed suicide, but Detective Dave Bannion (Glenn Ford) thinks there's more to the story. After talking to the man's mob-connected mistress, Bannion discovers far-reaching corruption that leads all the way from the police station to kingpin Mike Lagana (Alexander Scourby). But when the policeman's lover is killed, it becomes clear that crossing Lagana is a dangerous thing to do. Soon Bannion finds himself marked for death and his family in mortal danger.

673500.title: The Caine Mutiny
673500.description: During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.

673500.title: Ten Cents a Dance
673500.description: Barbara O'Neill (Barbara Stanwyck) is a poor dance hall girl who catches the eye of the wealthy Bradley Carlton (Ricardo Cortez). However, Barbara has feelings for her neighbor Eddie Miller (Monroe Owsley). After Eddie proposes to her, she says yes, and even secures a job for him from Bradley. Soon, though, Eddie has racked up deep gambling debts and even been unfaithful. Barbara continues to support him, but after he lashes out in jealousy she thinks maybe she should have chosen Bradley.

673500.title: American Madness
673500.description: During the Depression, the bank owned by generous Dickson (Walter Huston) is barely staying afloat, and things get worse when $100,000 is lifted from the vault. Fingers are pointed at reformed crook Matt (Pat O'Brien), who got a job and a fresh start from Dickson. The innocent Matt can clear his name by admitting that on the night of the robbery he was breaking up a tryst between Dickson's wife and another teller. But this revelation may crush Dickson, and Matt's conscience plays tug-of-war.

673500.title: The Collector
673500.description: A meek bank clerk and butterfly collector becomes increasingly obsessed with an art student who he’s determined to make fall in love with him.

673500.title: Autumn Leaves
673500.description: An aging, lonely spinster marries a good-looking younger man only to find that he has a very tormented past and is mentally disturbed.

673500.title: Bonjour tristesse
673500.description: At the height of summer, 18-year-old Cécile is relaxing by the French seaside with her father and falling in love with her new boyfriend. However, the arrival of her late mother's enigmatic friend soon turns her world upside down.

673498.title: Santa Fe
673498.description: Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.

673498.title: The Wild Westerners
673498.description: A U.S. marshal (James Philbrook) and his wife (Nancy Kovack) bring Union gold east through outlaws and Indians.

673498.title: Gunman's Walk
673498.description: Rancher Lee Hackett (Van Heflin) spends so much time trying to keep the violent streak of his son Ed (Tab Hunter) in check, he neglects the needs of his other son Davy (James Darren). When Ed's temper results in the death of an innocent Native American, Lee tries his best to cover his son's tracks by making a deal with unscrupulous horse trader Jensen (Ray Teal), who falsely testifies on Ed's behalf. But it becomes clear that Ed can't change, and a shootout between father and son ensues.

673498.title: Indian Uprising
673498.description: Gold thieves and the government rile Geronimo, despite a cavalry captain's (George Montgomery) efforts at peace.

673498.title: Return to Warbow
673498.description: Three escaped convicts return to collect the money that the brother of one of them has already spent.

673498.title: Jubal
673498.description: Searching for work, cowboy Jubal Troop (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small town, where he badly injures his hand. Fortunately, a local rancher, Shep Horgan (Ernest Borgnine), is willing to employ Troop despite the injury. Horgan and Troop work together amicably, but Horgan's two-timing wife (Valerie French) threatens to create discord when she becomes interested in Troop, although he really loves another woman. A jealous cowhand (Rod Steiger) complicates matters by spreading lies.

673498.title: Dirty Little Billy
673498.description: After his family moves to a frontier town in Kansas, city-bred teenager Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) finds he has no appetite for farming. He runs away, taking up with local outlaw Goldie (Richard Evans), who operates a saloon in town with the help of a prostitute named Berle (Lee Purcell). The three form a gang of sorts, menacing the locals until the townsfolk collectively decide to drive the outlaws away. Bonney escapes and begins the life of crime that makes him famous as Billy the Kid.

673498.title: Cripple Creek
673498.description: A federal agent (George Montgomery) and two colleagues infiltrate a gang of gold-rush gold smugglers.

673498.title: The Thrill Hunter
673498.description: After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

673498.title: Brave Warrior
673498.description: Shawnee chief Tecumseh (Jay Silverheels) helps a government agent (Jon Hall) catch traitors before the War of 1812.

673498.title: Major Dundee
673498.description: During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

673498.title: Western Code
673498.description: Tim Barrett, a renowned lawman, rescues Patty from a ruffian and saves her brother from being lynched.

673498.title: Gun Fury
673498.description: California-bound rancher Ben Warren (Rock Hudson) is shot and left for dead when a demented ex-Confederate, Frank Slayton (Phil Carey), kidnaps his Southern bride-to-be (Donna Reed). Revived, Ben sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he picks up Jess Burgess (Leo Gordon), a slighted former member of Slayton's gang, and American Indian local Johash (Pat Hogan), who has his own beef with the outlaws. Together they embark on a perilous chase toward the Mexican border to stop Slayton.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: While trapped in the ghost town saloon, Lucas tries to come up with a plan to escape with his son and Micah after Mark refuses to leave without him.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lou Mallory arrives in North Fork and starts buying up land and businesses. Lou and Lucas start disliking each other after she reveals plans to build a railroad on "worthless" land.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When a woman arrives in North Fork with symptoms of smallpox, Lucas, Lou Mallory, Doctor Burrage and hotel occupants are quarantined in the hotel with an outlaw.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Gunslinger Johnny Drako rides into town and tells the bartender that he is looking for Lucas McCain. After Johnny leaves the saloon, Sweeney hurries to tell Lucas.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle. After Lucas shoots a man during a robbery at the hotel, Mark and Lucas disagree his character.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men, until one of them shows up to challenge his story.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to to change his mind. He hires men to try to persuade Lucas, but he refuses.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas' is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The first railroad train is coming to the new North Fork station. On board is a Japanese nobleman and his servant, visiting the West to learn about the United States.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm. Lucas' life is endangered when a snake crawls into his bed.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a good friend from Lucas' past. But it's pleasure before business. Mario has been hired to kill Lucas.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The lazy Jackman brothers mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town. The family patriarch becomes marshal and deputizes his sons.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal who is now crippled and working for Lucas McCain.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch. Gibbs, a rodeo rider wanted by the law, begins stirring up trouble.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain to revenge himself on Lucas.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully ridicules his manner of speech and dress and provokes the Count to challenge him to a duel.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A new bank opens and Banker Hamilton hires a slow-witted gunman to guard the safe. When some of the gunman's old outlaw friends arrive in town they propose he join them in robbing the bank.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Mark tries to play Cupid between Lucas and a pretty young stranger who arrives in North Fork, the girl's two older brothers accuse him of trifling with her affections and challenge him to fight them both.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An arch-criminal has been run out of New Orleans and is passing through North Fork. Spotting the McCain ranch, he tells McCain he wants to buy it.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Young Dan Willard takes on Marshal Micah Torrence's job. With no experience, he takes a tough stand with a bunch of Texas cowhands whose high spirits are evident at the saloon.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas gets in trouble when he accuses the foreman of a neighboring ranch of rustling some of his cattle.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark are returning from a big cattle sale when the stage is robbed by three outlaws. Lucas, desperate to recover the money that was stolen, is determined to pursue the outlaws.

400000088.description: Dog is in Denver helping Bobby Brown to track down a fugitive with a long rap sheet. But unfortunately they have no picture of the felon to work with, so the challenges are big on this one.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Back in Colorado, Dog`s on the hunt for a runner with more than a decade's worth of trouble with the law.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Today Dog finds himself looking for more than one fugitive. He starts the day looking for a woman who has skipped out on her court date.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: A big heart can be a problem for a bail bondsman and today's hunt is a case in point. Dog gave a break to a young man with a drug problem who promised to enter drug rehab.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog's latest fugitive, doesn't think small when it comes to illegal drugs: he was carrying almost a pound of methamphetamine when he was arrested. Now he's on the run with his pregnant girlfriend on the high plains of Colorado.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

400000088.description: Fugitive beware: Dog's rolling with extra power today. His old friends Tim Chapman and Sonny Westbrook are riding with the team, so their target, a thief with violent tendencies, is out of luck.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog doesn't have the whole team today and he's got to catch a fugitive with a record of criminal assault. But when Dog finds the fugitive's former girlfriend, she thinks he isn't dangerous at all.

400000088.description: Dog's latest quarry is running from abuse and assault charges. As Dog investigates, he discovers that this fugitive has gamed the system by jumping from one bond, and one bondsman, to another.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
