10shakeperth.au.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E2 A Foot Too Big The Turtles discover Bigfoot in the woods, and Donnie befriends it, insisting they protect it from a hunter that is after it.

10shakeperth.au.title: Danny Phantom
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E12 Phantom Planet Part 1 Danny defeats Vlad, prompting Plasmius to exact revenge, which he does by creating Masters' Blasters, a team of hip ghost fighters whose amazing prowess renders Danny Phantom unnecessary.

10shakeperth.au.title: Invader Zim
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E16 Abducted / The Sad, Sad Tale Of Chickenfoot Dib sets out to prove that the supposed phenomenon of Chicken foot is nothing more than a guy in a costume. / Mistaken for an earthling, ZIM is captured by two moronic aliens.

10shakeperth.au.title: Hey Arnold!
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E9 The Aptitude Test / Oskar Gets A Job After the results of an aptitude test are announced, Harold gains self-confidence and Helga feels dumber. / Arnold is instrumental in persuading Oskar to actually get a temporary job.

10shakeperth.au.title: T.U.F.F Puppy
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E3 While The Cat's Away / Sweet Revenge Kitty is ordered to take a vacation and Dudley is assigned to teach her how to relax and not fight crime. // The Wannabee steals all the maple syrup in town so everyone will be forced to eat his product - honey on pancakes!

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S11 E9 Squid Noir/ Scavenger Pants When his clarinet goes missing, Squidward must become a hardboiled detective to find it. Squidward sends SpongeBob & Patrick on an increasingly difficult scavenger hunt to get them out of his hair.

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E17 The Bubble Bee-Athalon! The Guppies are busy turning nectar into honey. It takes a lot of teamwork every step of the way. Can the kids work together to make honey for the queen bee's teatime?

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E21 The Running of the Bullfrogs! Gil and Goby bring a tadpole named Fernando to school to watch him grow into a frog. Can Gil and Goby lead Fernando's back to his pond in the traditional Running of the Bullfrogs?

10shakeperth.au.title: Mr. Crocodile
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E2 Birthday Party / Tick Tock Mr. Croc Mr. Crocodile wants to be a good guest at Daisy's birthday party since he's never been to one before. // Rushing to get to a concert on time, Mr. Crocodile and Daisy misplace their tickets at Mom's Box and Ship Shop.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E23 Number 7 It seems that Rose has discovered how to make Monte laugh. She, Monte & Gardener Tim, find 7 colourful feathers in the garden and it seems a perfect time to meet the wonderful number 7.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S7 E7 Big Rig: Dolphin Delivery When a dolphin named Flippy needs help getting back to his family in the ocean, there's only one monster machine with enough power to get the job done: Big Rig Blaze!

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E12 Race To The Golden Gift Blaze is joined by all of his friends in the Race to the Golden Gift! But to win, they'll first have to get past Crusher and his fresh batch of cheats.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E19 Pups Save The White Wolf / Pups Save A Wrong-Way Explorer After a sudden snow storm, Everest cares for a wolf cub as they work together to help the PAW Patrol find them.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E20 Pups Save The Squirrels / Pups Save A Roo The PAW Patrol is on a roll when squirrels stash acorns in Alex's treehouse, causing it to fall onto Daring Danny's skateboard! // It's a switcheroo situation when a joey is separated from its mama!

10shakeperth.au.title: DORA
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E1 Dora's Pegaso Adventure Dora helps Ratoncito Perez fix his magic toothbrush wand to get a gift for her lost tooth. / Dora meets Carlos, a giant caterpillar, and helps him find butterberries to become a butterfly!

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E2 Unicornasaurus / The Grumple Games Dora helps Benny and Uni the Unicornasaurus recover their magic paintbrush to reunite with Bunnicorn. / She teams up with Hearty the Grumple to compete in the Grumple Games!

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E1 All I Want For Fishmas With Fishmas around the corner, the season's hottest toy- Burpin' Bubbz - is at the top of Baby Shark's and William's wish lists. But when Santa Jaws goes missing, it's up to them to save Fishmas.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E2 Fish Friends Forever / Jelly Pox Baby's rivalry with Shadow gets heated, when they enter a music competition. / Baby learns that when it comes to feeling better, there's no substitute to rest, covering your sneezes, and staying home.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ni Hao Kai Lan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E5 Kai-Lan's Big Play Kai-lan and her friends are putting on a play based on the Chinese folktale about the Monkey King. When Rintoo gets the part that Hoho wanted, Hoho quits the play and it's up to the viewer to help Kai-lan figure out what to do.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ni Hao Kai Lan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E6 Kai-Lan's Big Surprise Kai-lan needs our help to plan a very special party for Ye-Ye to thank him for all he does for us. But when everything she plans goes wrong, Kai-lan gets very frustrated and starts to cry.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E12 Pups Stop The Return Of Humsquatch / Pups Save A Lonely Ghost Eddie & Emmy get impatient, they hide in Mayor Humdinger's Humsquatch costume to chase everyone out. // Rubble dreams that he meets a ghost and learns it's not easy to help a ghost make friends.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E13 Pups Save a Floating Royal Carriage Pups Save a Floating Royal Carriage: After Sweetie decides to commandeer the Princess's royal carriage and horses, Sid the pirate sends Arrby to steal it. (S9, ep 13b).

10shakeperth.au.title: Unicorn Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E2 Year of the Unicorn On a Sapphire camping trip, a constellation that only appears every five years sends a special surprise down to Earth. But something troubles Wildstar...

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S7 E6 Carlita The Ice Cream Truck! Gabby unboxes an attachment that turns Carlita into an Ice Cream Truck! The only problem is...there's no ice cream! The Gabby Cats all help out to make ice cream and a groovy ice-cream truck song!

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E10 The Crew Demolishes A Rock Mountain Speed Meister sabotages a speeding train, accidentally sending it towards a huge mountain! Rubble & Crew introduce their new demolition vehicles to smash through the mountain and build a tunnel.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E11 The Crew Demolishes A Super Maze / The Crew Demolishes Through A Secret Cavern It's demolition time for Rubble & Crew when the Meister brothers' argument ends with big walls all over Builder Cove. // Rubble and the pups use their demolition vehicles to save Truffles.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E19 The Number 6 To teach Monte and Col about the number 6, Gardener Tim invites them to count different objects like: six boats, six airplane toys, six car toys, six teddy bears, and more.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E11 Pups Save The Land Pirates / Pups Save The Birdwatching Turbots Pirates Alex, Julia, Julius and Chick-ARR-letta, are sent sailing into the desert and got lost! It's up to the PAW Patrol to save these Land pirates.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E12 Mighty Pups: Pups And The Mighty Twins Super-bandit, Ladybird, shrieks havoc in Adventure Bay taking all of the town's treasures - including Mayor Goodway!

10shakeperth.au.title: Henry Danger
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E24 Story Tank Big stakes are on the line when Henry claims he can't be scared. Schwoz uses a machine that allows Henry to experience the spooky stories that everyone in the Man Cave tells him.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Creature Cases
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E9 The Unidentified Shiny Object / The Case Of The Crying Monkey Mysterious lights are messing up the dancing at the firefly prom. // The duo follows the jungle sounds to locate a baby monkey.

10shakeperth.au.title: Pig Goat Banana Cricket
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E17 Total Bananarchy Pig wishes to the President for his birthday. Banana recruits Shragger as his bodyguard. Goat builds a sculpture for Pig's birthday. Cricket flees to Mars for a more organized society.

10shakeperth.au.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E12 The Ho! Ho! Horror!/outhouse Outrage Santa Claus visits the children, who aren't quite sure what to make of the jolly giant. // The outhouse explodes in front of Mr. Krabs, but he gets three different sides of the story from his campers.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Patrick Star Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E3 A Tinkle In Time / TV Or Not TV Tinkle stumbles into a time-travelling adventure. Patrick and Squidina aren't allowed to watch TV when they spend time with their parents for a day.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E15 Dylan Vs. Mystery X Dylan's popularity skyrockets after an online rap battle with a rival, but the pressure to settle the beef creates new problems. Rebecca's church solo spurs Yasmine and Viola to offer fashion advice.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E16 Bunk Hate Rebecca's assignment to study animals in the wild leads her to observe (and sometimes provoke) Dylan and Charlie as they battle for supremacy in their small shared bedroom.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rock Paper Scissors
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E17 The Family Business / Glitter Bomb When Rock's dad comes to town, Rock joins the family business in an attempt to finally impress his father. // After receiving a glitter bomb in the mail, Rock vows revenge on the anonymous bomber.

10shakeperth.au.title: Max & the Midknights
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E10 Tomb Of The Bodkin Max & the Midknights journey to an ancient tomb to investigate the legend of King Torin and his Bodkin, where they make several unexpected discoveries.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Loud House
10shakeperth.au.description: S10 E4 Clyde Can't Decide / Shred Of Evidence Clyde can't get a hold of his therapist and struggles to make even the smallest decisions. // Lola and her nemesis, Lindsey Sweetwater, join forces to uncover a mystery while competing at a pageant.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E16 Born Again Krabs/ I Had An Accident Mr Krabs gets ill after eating an old Krabby Patty that he refused to throw away. // SpongeBob has an accident while sand sledding! Afraid for his safety, he won't leave his house.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E17 Krabby Land/ The Camping Episode Mr Krabs aims to squeeze every penny out of kids on summer break by building a playground in the Krusty Krab. Then, SpongeBob and Patrick lure Squidward to their backyard campout.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S15 E7 Wary Gary / Pinned SpongeBob goes to extreme lengths to trick Gary into visiting the vet. / Desperate, SpongeBob gets pinned under his exercise equipment and must wait for help to arrive.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S15 E8 Jeffy T's Prankwell Emporium / A Taste Of Plankton Squidward's prankster dad visits, bringing all sorts of gags (much to Squidward's annoyance). / Plankton tries to steal the secret formula by attaching himself to SpongeBob's tongue.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S15 E9 Smartificial Intelligence / Firehouse Bob Perch fights to keep his job after being fired and replaced by a robot anchorman. / SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward feel the heat when they become volunteer firefighters.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S15 E10 Pablum Plankton / Musebob Modelpants Plankton wins a cutest baby contest and becomes the face of a baby food brand. / Squidward's one-off portrait of SpongeBob takes the art world by storm, forcing him to create more.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S15 E11 Delivery Of Doom / My Father The Boat SpongeBob is challenged by E.V.I.L. to deliver to their secret lair in 10 minutes or less. / Mr Krabs gets trapped inside Pearl's new boat and must pretend to be its engine to avoid being caught.

abcentertains.au.description: Medusa visits Hotel Transylvania and soon after she arrives, someone starts messing with Aunt Lydia's hair. Medusa is obviously suspect number one and yet she's nowhere to be found. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.description: The Bears have fun at Charlie's private lake. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Teen Titans Go! - Wally T
abcentertains.au.description: The Titans discover the magic of \. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir - Dearest Family
abcentertains.au.description: Galette day this year is eventful for Marinette; Tikki is acting very strange and three supervillains show up! Will Ladybug still manage to establish herself as queen of the day? (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Moominvalley - The Strange Case of Mrs Fillyjonk
abcentertains.au.description: When Moominmamma is accused of an unlikely crime, Moomintroll turns detective to try to save her. Can he succeed where his father couldn't? (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Mechamato - Fulus Pyramid
abcentertains.au.description: When Mara is trapped inside a board game owned by the bad robot Fulus the First, it is up to Amato and friends to beat the game and free themselves. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: 100% Wolf: Legend of the Moonstone - Night Of The Poodle
abcentertains.au.description: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy's entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits (and his best friend Batty's help) to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Renn Scare
abcentertains.au.description: The gang heads to the Velma's beloved authentic Renaissance Faire, where they must find a way to infiltrate the royal feast in order to stop an evil court jester from ending the king's reign. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Summer Camp Island - A Barb is Born

abcentertains.au.title: Total Drama Island: Reboot - Meet the Victims
abcentertains.au.description: Chris welcomes 16 new campers back to the original island and divides them into two teams who face-off in a blindfolded challenge that's sure to cause pain. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series - What About Blob?
abcentertains.au.description: Mavis and Wendy are feeling suffocated by the grown-ups in their lives. They'd do anything to get them off their case. The solution? They set them up on an ill-advised date. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Submarine Jim - Dear Diary

abcentertains.au.title: The InBESTigators - The Case Of The Baffling Birthday
abcentertains.au.description: Ava wants to give Maudie her first proper birthday party, but Maudie gets sidetracked by a mystery. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Badjelly - Shark Thursday
abcentertains.au.description: Mudwiggle ferries our heroes through shark infested waters - with a Dulboot in hot pursuit. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: GG: Spawn Squad - Jamie And Gem Make A Huge Mess!

abcentertains.au.title: Unikitty - Special Delivery
abcentertains.au.description: After being rudely interrupted by Bim Bom during her daily morning song, an angry Unikitty takes the advice of her friends and writes down her feelings into a letter with the intention of keeping the letter to herself. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Unikitty - Dunklecorn
abcentertains.au.description: A mysterious relative, Uncle Donklecorn, shows up unexpectedly. Hawkodile thinks it's just Master Frown and Brock in a donkey costume, trying to ruin things as usual, but Unikitty & Puppycorn are convinced Donklecorn. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Summer Camp Island - Time-Travelling Quick Pants
